2.25.s:
śailādiruvāca
śivāgnikāryaṃ vakṣyāmi śivena paribhāṣitam /
janayitvāgrataḥ prācīṃ śubhe deśe susaṃskṛte //
2.25.d:
शैलादिरुवाच
शिवाग्निकार्यं वक्ष्यामि शिवेन परिभाषितम् ।
जनयित्वाग्रतः प्राचीं शुभे देशे सुसंस्कृते ॥
2.25.m: Śailādi said: / I shall declare the ritual of Śiva's fire, as enunciated by Śiva, / having first determined the east in an auspicious, well-prepared site.

2.25.s:
pūrvāgramuttarāgraṃ ca kuryātsūtratrayaṃśubham /
caturastrīkṛte kṣetre kuryātkuṇḍāni yatnataḥ //
2.25.d:
पूर्वाग्रमुत्तराग्रं च कुर्यात्सूत्रत्रयंशुभम् ।
चतुरस्त्रीकृते क्षेत्रे कुर्यात्कुण्डानि यत्नतः ॥
2.25.m: One should draw three auspicious lines pointing east and pointing north. / In the squared-off ground, one should diligently prepare the pits.

2.25.s:
nityahomāgnikuṇḍaṃ ca trimekhalasamāyutam /
catustridvyaṅgulāyāmā mekhalā hastamātrataḥ //
2.25.d:
नित्यहोमाग्निकुण्डं च त्रिमेखलसमायुतम् ।
चतुस्त्रिद्व्यङ्गुलायामा मेखला हस्तमात्रतः ॥
2.25.m: And the fire-pit for the daily oblation is endowed with three tiers. / The tiers are four, three, and two finger-breadths in extent, [rising] from a measure of one cubit.

2.25.s:
hastamātraṃ bhavetkuṇḍaṃ yoniḥ prādeśamātrataḥ /
aśvatthapatravadyonīṃ mekhalopari kalpayet //
2.25.d:
हस्तमात्रं भवेत्कुण्डं योनिः प्रादेशमात्रतः ।
अश्वत्थपत्रवद्योनीं मेखलोपरि कल्पयेत् ॥
2.25.m: The pit should be one cubit in measure; the vulva-channel is a span in measure. / One should fashion the vulva-channel like an aśvattha leaf upon the tier.

2.25.s:
kuṇḍamadhye tu nābhiḥ syādaṣṭapatraṃ sakarṇikam /
prādeśamātraṃ vidhinā kārayedbrahmaṇaḥ suta //
2.25.d:
कुण्डमध्ये तु नाभिः स्यादष्टपत्रं सकर्णिकम् ।
प्रादेशमात्रं विधिना कारयेद्ब्रह्मणः सुत ॥
2.25.m: In the middle of the pit there should be a navel, eight-petalled, with a pericarp, / measuring a span; O son of Brahmā, one should have it made according to rule.

2.25.s:
ṣaṣṭhenollekhanaṃ proktaṃ prokṣaṇaṃ varmaṇā smṛtam /
netreṇālokya vai kuṇḍaṃ ṣaḍrekhāḥ kārayedbudhaḥ //
2.25.d:
षष्ठेनोल्लेखनं प्रोक्तं प्रोक्षणं वर्मणा स्मृतम् ।
नेत्रेणालोक्य वै कुण्डं षड्रेखाः कारयेद्बुधः ॥
2.25.m: Marking [the pit] is said [to be done] with the sixth [mantra]; sprinkling is remembered to be with the armor [mantra]. / Having looked upon the pit with the eye [mantra], the wise person should make six lines.

2.25.s:
prāgāyatena viprendra brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ /
uttarāgrāḥ śivā rekhāḥ prokṣayedvarmaṇā punaḥ //
2.25.d:
प्रागायतेन विप्रेन्द्र ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेश्वराः ।
उत्तराग्राः शिवा रेखाः प्रोक्षयेद्वर्मणा पुनः ॥
2.25.m: The lines pointing east, O best of Brahmins, are Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Maheśvara; / the lines pointing north are Śiva; one should sprinkle them again with the armor [mantra].

2.25.s:
śamīpippalasaṃbhūtāmaraṇīṃ ṣoḍaśāṅgulām /
mathitvā vahnibījena śaktinyāsaṃ hṛdaiva tu //
2.25.d:
शमीपिप्पलसंभूतामरणीं षोडशाङ्गुलाम् ।
मथित्वा वह्निबीजेन शक्तिन्यासं हृदैव तु ॥
2.25.m: Having churned the fire-drill sixteen finger-breadths in size, born of the śamī and pippala trees, / with the fire-seed-mantra, [one performs] the installation of the power with the heart [mantra].

2.25.s:
prakṣipedvidhinā vahnimanvādhāya yathāvidhi /
tūṣṇīṃ prādeśamātraistu yājñikaiḥ śakalaiḥ śubhaiḥ //
2.25.d:
प्रक्षिपेद्विधिना वह्निमन्वाधाय यथाविधि ।
तूष्णीं प्रादेशमात्रैस्तु याज्ञिकैः शकलैः शुभैः ॥
2.25.m: Having added fuel according to rule, one should cast in the fire according to rule, / silently, with auspicious sacrificial kindling-sticks measuring merely a span.

2.25.s:
parisaṃmohanaṃ kuryājjalenāṣṭasu dikṣu vai /
paristīrya vidhānena prāgādyevamanukramāt //
2.25.d:
परिसंमोहनं कुर्याज्जलेनाष्टसु दिक्षु वै ।
परिस्तीर्य विधानेन प्रागाद्येवमनुक्रमात् ॥
2.25.m: One should perform the encircling with water in the eight directions; / having strewn [grass] around according to the rite, beginning from the east in this order:

2.25.s:
uttarāgraṃ purastāddhi prāgagraṃ dakṣiṇe punaḥ /
paścime cottarāgraṃ tu saumye pūrvāgrameva tu //
2.25.d:
उत्तराग्रं पुरस्ताद्धि प्रागग्रं दक्षिणे पुनः ।
पश्चिमे चोत्तराग्रं तु सौम्ये पूर्वाग्रमेव तु ॥
2.25.m: pointing north in the east, and pointing east in the south; / pointing north in the west, and pointing east in the north.

2.25.s:
aindre caindrāgramāvāhya yāmya evaṃ vidhīyate /
saumyasyoparicāndrāgnaṃ vāruṇāgnamadhastataḥ //
2.25.d:
ऐन्द्रे चैन्द्राग्रमावाह्य याम्य एवं विधीयते ।
सौम्यस्योपरिचान्द्राग्नं वारुणाग्नमधस्ततः ॥
2.25.m: Invoking [the fire] pointing east in the east, the same is prescribed in the south; / above the north pointing east, and beneath pointing west.

2.25.s:
dvandvarūpeṇa pātrāṇi barhaḥṣvāsādya suvrata /
adhomukhāni sarvāṇi dravyāṇi ca tathottare //
2.25.d:
द्वन्द्वरूपेण पात्राणि बर्हःष्वासाद्य सुव्रत ।
अधोमुखानि सर्वाणि द्रव्याणि च तथोत्तरे ॥
2.25.m: Having placed the vessels in pairs upon the sacrificial grasses, O you of good vows, / all turned downwards, and likewise the materials in the north,

2.25.s:
tasyopari nyaseddarbhāñchivaṃ dakṣiṇatonyaset /
pūjayenmūlamantreṇa paścāddhomaṃ samācaret //
2.25.d:
तस्योपरि न्यसेद्दर्भाञ्छिवं दक्षिणतोन्यसेत् ।
पूजयेन्मूलमन्त्रेण पश्चाद्धोमं समाचरेत् ॥
2.25.m: one should place darbha grasses upon it; one should place Śiva in the south. / One should worship with the root mantra; thereafter, one should perform the oblation.

2.25.s:
prokṣaṇīpātramādāya pūrayedaṃbunā punaḥ /
prādesamātrau tu kuśau sthāpayedudakopari //
2.25.d:
प्रोक्षणीपात्रमादाय पूरयेदंबुना पुनः ।
प्रादेसमात्रौ तु कुशौ स्थापयेदुदकोपरि ॥
2.25.m: Taking the vessel for sprinkling-water, one should fill it again with water. / One should place two kuśa blades, measuring a span, upon the water.

2.25.s:
plāvayecca kuśāgraṃ tu vasoḥ sūryasya raśmibhiḥ /
vikīrya sarvapātrāṇi susaṃprokṣya vidhānataḥ //
2.25.d:
प्लावयेच्च कुशाग्रं तु वसोः सूर्यस्य रश्मिभिः ।
विकीर्य सर्वपात्राणि सुसंप्रोक्ष्य विधानतः ॥
2.25.m: One should submerge the tip of the kuśa [reciting] 'By the rays of the wealthy sun,' / and having strewn all the vessels and sprinkled them thoroughly according to the rite,

2.25.s:
praṇītāpātramādāya pūrayedaṃbunā punaḥ /
anyodakakuśagraistu samyagācchādya suvrata //
2.25.d:
प्रणीतापात्रमादाय पूरयेदंबुना पुनः ।
अन्योदककुशग्रैस्तु सम्यगाच्छाद्य सुव्रत ॥
2.25.m: taking the praṇītā vessel, one should fill it again with water; / having covered it completely with the tips of kuśa grasses with other water, O you of good vows,

2.25.s:
hastābhyāṃ nāsikaṃ pātramaiśānyāṃ diśi vinyaset /
ājyādhiśrayaṇaṃ kuryātpaścimottarataḥ śubham //
2.25.d:
हस्ताभ्यां नासिकं पात्रमैशान्यां दिशि विन्यसेत् ।
आज्याधिश्रयणं कुर्यात्पश्चिमोत्तरतः शुभम् ॥
2.25.m: with both hands one should place the vessel at nose-level in the north-east direction. / One should perform the heating of the clarified butter in the north-west, an auspicious act.

2.25.s:
bhasmamiśrāṃstathāṅgārān grāhayetsakalena vai /
paścimottarato nītvā tatra cājyaṃ pratāpayet //
2.25.d:
भस्ममिश्रांस्तथाङ्गारान् ग्राहयेत्सकलेन वै ।
पश्चिमोत्तरतो नीत्वा तत्र चाज्यं प्रतापयेत् ॥
2.25.m: One should take burning embers mixed with ashes with the sakala [mantra]; / having brought them to the north-west, one should heat the clarified butter there.

2.25.s:
kuśānagnau tu prajvālya paryagniṃ tribhirācaret /
tānsarvāṃstatra niḥkṣipya cāgre cājyaṃ nidhāpayet //
2.25.d:
कुशानग्नौ तु प्रज्वाल्य पर्यग्निं त्रिभिराचरेत् ।
तान्सर्वांस्तत्र निःक्षिप्य चाग्रे चाज्यं निधापयेत् ॥
2.25.m: Igniting kuśa blades in the fire, one should carry the fire around [it] three times. / Having cast them all therein, one should set down the clarified butter in front.

2.25.s:
aṅguṣṭhamātrau tu kuśau prakṣālya vidhinaiva tu /
paryagniṃ ca tataḥ kuryāttaireva navabhiḥ punaḥ //
2.25.d:
अङ्गुष्ठमात्रौ तु कुशौ प्रक्षाल्य विधिनैव तु ।
पर्यग्निं च ततः कुर्यात्तैरेव नवभिः पुनः ॥
2.25.m: Having washed two kuśa blades measuring the length of a thumb according to rule, / one should then perform the carrying of fire around [it] again with those nine [blades].

2.25.s:
paryagniṃ ca punaḥ kuryāttadājyamavaropayet /
athāpakarṣayet pātraṃ krameṇottarapaścime //
2.25.d:
पर्यग्निं च पुनः कुर्यात्तदाज्यमवरोपयेत् ।
अथापकर्षयेत् पात्रं क्रमेणोत्तरपश्चिमे ॥
2.25.m: One should perform the carrying of fire around [it] again, and take down that clarified butter. / Then one should move the vessel sequentially to the north-west.

2.25.s:
saṃyujya cāgniṃ kāṣṭhena prakṣālyāropya paścime /
ājyasyotpavanaṃ kuryātpavitrābhyāṃ sahaiva tu //
2.25.d:
संयुज्य चाग्निं काष्ठेन प्रक्षाल्यारोप्य पश्चिमे ।
आज्यस्योत्पवनं कुर्यात्पवित्राभ्यां सहैव तु ॥
2.25.m: Uniting the fire with wood, having washed and placed it in the west, / one should perform the purification of the clarified butter together with the two strainers.

2.25.s:
pṛthagādāya hastābhyāṃ pravāheṇa yathākramam /
aṅguṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃ tu ubhābhyāṃ mūlavidyayā //
2.25.d:
पृथगादाय हस्ताभ्यां प्रवाहेण यथाक्रमम् ।
अङ्गुष्ठानामिकाभ्यां तु उभाभ्यां मूलविद्यया ॥
2.25.m: Taking them separately with both hands, through the stream in proper order, / with both the thumb and the ring finger, using the root formula,

2.25.s:
abhyukṣya dāpayedagnau pavitre ghṛtapaṅkite /
sauvarṇaṃ sruksruvaṃ kuryādratnimātreṇa suvrata //
2.25.d:
अभ्युक्ष्य दापयेदग्नौ पवित्रे घृतपङ्किते ।
सौवर्णं स्रुक्स्रुवं कुर्याद्रत्निमात्रेण सुव्रत ॥
2.25.m: having sprinkled, one should cast into the fire the two strainers smeared with ghee. / One should make the ladle and spoon of gold, measuring an aratni, O you of good vows,

2.25.s:
rājataṃ vā yathānyāyaṃ sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutam /
athavā yājñikairvṛkṣaiḥ kartavyau sruksruvā vubhau //
2.25.d:
राजतं वा यथान्यायं सर्वलक्षणसंयुतम् ।
अथवा याज्ञिकैर्वृक्षैः कर्तव्यौ स्रुक्स्रुवा वुभौ ॥
2.25.m: or of silver according to rule, endowed with all auspicious marks; / or both the ladle and the spoon should be made of sacrificial trees.

2.25.s:
aratnimātramāyāmaṃ tatpotre tu bilaṃ bhavet /
ṣaḍaṅgulaparīṇāhṝṃ daṇḍamūlaṃ mahāmune //
2.25.d:
अरत्निमात्रमायामं तत्पोत्रे तु बिलं भवेत् ।
षडङ्गुलपरीणाहॄं दण्डमूलं महामुने ॥
2.25.m: The length should be the measure of an aratni; there should be a cavity in its snout. / The base of the handle should have a circumference of six finger-breadths, O great sage;

2.25.s:
tadardhaṃ kaṇṭhānālaṃ syātpuṣkaraṃ mūlavadbhavet /
govālasadṛśaṃ daṇḍaṃ mruvāgraṃ nāsikāsamam //
2.25.d:
तदर्धं कण्ठानालं स्यात्पुष्करं मूलवद्भवेत् ।
गोवालसदृशं दण्डं म्रुवाग्रं नासिकासमम् ॥
2.25.m: its throat and tube should be half of that; the lotus-bowl should be like the base. / The handle should resemble a cow's tail; the tip of the spoon should be like a nose,

2.25.s:
puṭadvayasamāyuktaṃ muktādyena prapūritam /
ṣaṭtriṃśadaṅgulāyāmamaṣṭāṅgulasavistaram //
2.25.d:
पुटद्वयसमायुक्तं मुक्ताद्येन प्रपूरितम् ।
षट्त्रिंशदङ्गुलायाममष्टाङ्गुलसविस्तरम् ॥
2.25.m: furnished with two folds, filled with pearls and the like, / thirty-six finger-breadths in length, eight finger-breadths in breadth.

2.25.s:
utsedhastu tadardhaṃ syātsūtreṇa samitaṃ tataḥ /
saptāṅgulaṃ bhavedāsyaṃ vistarāyāmataḥ punaḥ //
2.25.d:
उत्सेधस्तु तदर्धं स्यात्सूत्रेण समितं ततः ।
सप्ताङ्गुलं भवेदास्यं विस्तरायामतः पुनः ॥
2.25.m: Its height should be half of that, measured by a cord from there. / Its mouth should be seven finger-breadths in width and length;

2.25.s:
tribhāgaikaṃ bhavedagraṃ kṛtvā śeṣaṃ parityajet /
kaṇṭhaṃ ca dvyaṅgulāyāmaṃ vistāraṃ caturaṅgulam //
2.25.d:
त्रिभागैकं भवेदग्रं कृत्वा शेषं परित्यजेत् ।
कण्ठं च द्व्यङ्गुलायामं विस्तारं चतुरङ्गुलम् ॥
2.25.m: the tip should be one-third; having made it, one should discard the remainder. / The neck is two finger-breadths in length and four finger-breadths in width.

2.25.s:
vediraṣṭāṅgulāyāmāvistārastatpramāṇataḥ /
tasya madhye bilaṃ kuryāccaturaṅgulamānataḥ //
2.25.d:
वेदिरष्टाङ्गुलायामाविस्तारस्तत्प्रमाणतः ।
तस्य मध्ये बिलं कुर्याच्चतुरङ्गुलमानतः ॥
2.25.m: The altar is eight finger-breadths in length, and its width is of that same measure. / In its middle, one should make a cavity measuring four finger-breadths.

2.25.s:
bilaṃ suvartitaṃ kuryādaṣṭapatraṃ sukarṇikam /
parito bilabāhye tu paṭṭikārdhāṅgulena tu //
2.25.d:
बिलं सुवर्तितं कुर्यादष्टपत्रं सुकर्णिकम् ।
परितो बिलबाह्ये तु पट्टिकार्धाङ्गुलेन तु ॥
2.25.m: One should make the cavity well-rounded, eight-petalled, with an attractive pericarp. / All around, outside the cavity, there should be a border of half a finger-breadth.

2.25.s:
tadbrāhme ca vinidaṃ tu padmapatravicitritam /
yavadvayapramāṇena tadbrāhme paṭṭikā bhavet //
2.25.d:
तद्ब्राह्मे च विनिदं तु पद्मपत्रविचित्रितम् ।
यवद्वयप्रमाणेन तद्ब्राह्मे पट्टिका भवेत् ॥
2.25.m: In its Brahmā-portion is that cavity, decorated with lotus petals. / Measuring two barley-corns, there should be a border in that Brahmā-portion.

2.25.s:
vedikāmadhyato randhraṃ kaniṣṭhāṅgulamānataḥ /
khātaṃ yāvanmukhāntaḥ syādbilamānaṃ tu nimragam //
2.25.d:
वेदिकामध्यतो रन्ध्रं कनिष्ठाङ्गुलमानतः ।
खातं यावन्मुखान्तः स्याद्बिलमानं तु निम्रगम् ॥
2.25.m: From the middle of the platform there is an aperture measuring the little finger, / a hollow extending as far as the mouth, with the cavity sloping downward.

2.25.s:
daṇḍaṃ ṣaḍaṅgulaṃ nālaṃ daṇḍāgre daṇḍikātrayam /
ardhāṅgulavivṛddhyātu kartavyaṃ caturaṅgulam //
2.25.d:
दण्डं षडङ्गुलं नालं दण्डाग्रे दण्डिकात्रयम् ।
अर्धाङ्गुलविवृद्ध्यातु कर्तव्यं चतुरङ्गुलम् ॥
2.25.m: The handle is a six-finger-breadth tube; at the tip of the handle are three small rods. / It should be made four finger-breadths, increasing by half a finger-breadth.

2.25.s:
trayodaśāṅgulāyāmaṃ daṇḍamūle ghaṭaṃ bhavet /
dvyaṅgulastu bhavetkuṃbho nābhiṃ vidyāddaśāṅgulam //
2.25.d:
त्रयोदशाङ्गुलायामं दण्डमूले घटं भवेत् ।
द्व्यङ्गुलस्तु भवेत्कुंभो नाभिं विद्याद्दशाङ्गुलम् ॥
2.25.m: There should be a pot of thirteen fingers' length at the base of the handle; / the vessel should be two fingers, and one should know the hub to be ten fingers.

2.25.s:
vedimadhye tathā kṛtvā pādaṃ kuryācca dvyaṅgulam /
padmapṛṣṭhasamākāraṃ pādaṃ vai karṇikākṛtim //
2.25.d:
वेदिमध्ये तथा कृत्वा पादं कुर्याच्च द्व्यङ्गुलम् ।
पद्मपृष्ठसमाकारं पादं वै कर्णिकाकृतिम् ॥
2.25.m: Having made it thus in the middle of the altar, one should make a foot of two fingers; / the foot should indeed have the appearance of the back of a lotus, shaped like a pericarp.

2.25.s:
gajoṣṭhasadṛśākāraṃ tasya pṛṣṭhākṛtirbhavet /
abhicārādikāryeṣu kuryātkṛṣṇāyasena tu //
2.25.d:
गजोष्ठसदृशाकारं तस्य पृष्ठाकृतिर्भवेत् ।
अभिचारादिकार्येषु कुर्यात्कृष्णायसेन तु ॥
2.25.m: The form of its back should resemble the lip of an elephant. / But in rites of sorcery and the like, one should make it of black iron.

2.25.s:
pañcaviṃśatkuśenaiva sruksruvau mārjayet punaḥ /
agramagreṇa saṃśodhya madhyaṃ madhyena suvrata //
2.25.d:
पञ्चविंशत्कुशेनैव स्रुक्स्रुवौ मार्जयेत् पुनः ।
अग्रमग्रेण संशोध्य मध्यं मध्येन सुव्रत ॥
2.25.m: Then, with twenty-five blades of kuśa grass, one should wipe the sruc and sruva ladles, / cleansing tip with tip, middle with middle, O one of good vows,

2.25.s:
mūlaṃ mūlena vidhinā agnau tāpya hṛdā punaḥ /
ājyasthālī praṇītā ca prokṣaṇī tisra eva ca //
2.25.d:
मूलं मूलेन विधिना अग्नौ ताप्य हृदा पुनः ।
आज्यस्थाली प्रणीता च प्रोक्षणी तिस्र एव च ॥
2.25.m: [and] base with base according to the rule, having heated them again in the fire with the heart-mantra. / And there are three [vessels]: the ghee-pot, the praṇītā, and the prokṣaṇī;

2.25.s:
sauvarṇī rājatī vāpi tāmrī vā mṛnmayī tu vā /
anyathā naiva kartavyaṃ śāntike pauṣṭike śubhe //
2.25.d:
सौवर्णी राजती वापि ताम्री वा मृन्मयी तु वा ।
अन्यथा नैव कर्तव्यं शान्तिके पौष्टिके शुभे ॥
2.25.m: they may be of gold, silver, copper, or made of clay. / It should never be done otherwise in auspicious rites for appeasement and nourishment.

2.25.s:
āyasī tvabhicāre tu śāntike mṛnmayī tu vā /
ṣaḍaṅgulaṃ suvistīrṇaṃ pātrāṇāṃ mukhamucyate //
2.25.d:
आयसी त्वभिचारे तु शान्तिके मृन्मयी तु वा ।
षडङ्गुलं सुविस्तीर्णं पात्राणां मुखमुच्यते ॥
2.25.m: In sorcery, however, it should be of iron, or in appeasement of clay. / The mouth of the vessels is said to be six fingers wide.

2.25.s:
prokṣaṇī dvyaṅgulotsedhā praṇītā dvyaṅgulādhikā /
ājyasthālī tatastasyā utsedho dvyaṅgulādhikaḥ //
2.25.d:
प्रोक्षणी द्व्यङ्गुलोत्सेधा प्रणीता द्व्यङ्गुलाधिका ।
आज्यस्थाली ततस्तस्या उत्सेधो द्व्यङ्गुलाधिकः ॥
2.25.m: The prokṣaṇī is two fingers high, the praṇītā two fingers higher; / then the height of the ghee-pot is two fingers higher than that.

2.25.s:
yaiḥ samidbhirhutaṃ proktaṃ taireva paridhirbhavet /
madhyāṅgulaparīṇāhā avakraā nirvraṇāḥ samāḥ //
2.25.d:
यैः समिद्भिर्हुतं प्रोक्तं तैरेव परिधिर्भवेत् ।
मध्याङ्गुलपरीणाहा अवक्रआ निर्व्रणाः समाः ॥
2.25.m: The boundary sticks should be made from the very same firewood with which the oblation was prescribed, / having the circumference of the middle finger, unbent, free of flaws, and straight.

2.25.s:
dvātriṃśadaṅgulāyāmāstisraḥ paridhayaḥsmṛtāḥ /
dvātriṃśadaṅgulāyāmaistriṃśaddarbhaiḥ paristaret //
2.25.d:
द्वात्रिंशदङ्गुलायामास्तिस्रः परिधयःस्मृताः ।
द्वात्रिंशदङ्गुलायामैस्त्रिंशद्दर्भैः परिस्तरेत् ॥
2.25.m: The three boundary sticks are taught to be thirty-two fingers long. / One should spread thirty darbha grasses thirty-two fingers long.

2.25.s:
caturaṅgulamadhye tu grathitaṃ tu pradākṣiṇam /
abhicārādikāryeṣu śivāgnyādhānavarjitam //
2.25.d:
चतुरङ्गुलमध्ये तु ग्रथितं तु प्रदाक्षिणम् ।
अभिचारादिकार्येषु शिवाग्न्याधानवर्जितम् ॥
2.25.m: Tied in the middle of four fingers, circumambulating clockwise; / in rites of sorcery and the like, it is devoid of the establishment of the fire of Śiva.

2.25.s:
akomalāḥ sthirā vipra saṃgrāhyastvābhicārike /
samagrāḥ susamāḥ sthūlāḥ kaniṣṭhāṅgulasaṃmitāḥ //
2.25.d:
अकोमलाः स्थिरा विप्र संग्राह्यस्त्वाभिचारिके ।
समग्राः सुसमाः स्थूलाः कनिष्ठाङ्गुलसंमिताः ॥
2.25.m: For a sorcery rite, O brahmin, [the fire-sticks] to be gathered should be hard and firm, / complete, very straight, thick, equal to the little finger [in girth],

2.25.s:
avakraānirvraṇāḥ srigdhā dvādaśāṅgulasaṃmitāḥ /
samidhasthaṃ pramāṇaṃ hi sarvakāryeṣu suvrata //
2.25.d:
अवक्रआनिर्व्रणाः स्रिग्धा द्वादशाङ्गुलसंमिताः ।
समिधस्थं प्रमाणं हि सर्वकार्येषु सुव्रत ॥
2.25.m: unbent, free of flaws, smooth, and twelve fingers long. / For such is the measure of the firewood in all rites, O one of good vows.

2.25.s:
gavyaṃ ghṛtaṃ tataḥ śreṣṭha kāpilaṃ tu tato 'dhikam /
āhutīnāṃ gramaṇaṃ tu mruvaṃ pūrṇaṃ yathā bhavet //
2.25.d:
गव्यं घृतं ततः श्रेष्ठ कापिलं तु ततो ऽधिकम् ।
आहुतीनां ग्रमणं तु म्रुवं पूर्णं यथा भवेत् ॥
2.25.m: Ghee from cows is best, and that from kapilā cows is higher still. / The measure of the oblations should be such that the sruva is full.

2.25.s:
annamakṣapramāṇaṃ syācchuktimātreṇa vai tilaḥ /
yavānāṃ ca tadardhaṃ syātphalānāṃ svapramāṇataḥ //
2.25.d:
अन्नमक्षप्रमाणं स्याच्छुक्तिमात्रेण वै तिलः ।
यवानां च तदर्धं स्यात्फलानां स्वप्रमाणतः ॥
2.25.m: Cooked food should be the size of an akṣa [nut], and sesame seeds merely a oyster-shell's capacity; / of barley grains it should be half of that, and of fruits according to their own size.

2.25.s:
kṣirasya madhuno dadhnaḥ pramāṇaṃ ghṛtavadbhavet /
catuḥmruvapramāṇena mrucā pūrṇāhutirbhavet //
2.25.d:
क्षिरस्य मधुनो दध्नः प्रमाणं घृतवद्भवेत् ।
चतुःम्रुवप्रमाणेन म्रुचा पूर्णाहुतिर्भवेत् ॥
2.25.m: The measure of milk, honey, and curd should be like that of ghee. / The full oblation should be made with the sruc ladle to the measure of four sruvas.

2.25.s:
tadardhaṃ sviṣṭakṛtproktaṃ śeṣaṃ sarvamathāpi vā /
śāntikaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ caiva śivāgnau juhuyātsadā //
2.25.d:
तदर्धं स्विष्टकृत्प्रोक्तं शेषं सर्वमथापि वा ।
शान्तिकं पौष्टिकं चैव शिवाग्नौ जुहुयात्सदा ॥
2.25.m: Half of that is said to be for the Sviṣṭakṛt, or indeed whatever remains. / One should always offer pacifying and nourishing rites in the fire of Śiva.

2.25.s:
laukikāgnau mahābhāga mohanoccāṭanādayaḥ /
śivāgniṃ janayitvā tu sarvakarmāṇe suvrata //
2.25.d:
लौकिकाग्नौ महाभाग मोहनोच्चाटनादयः ।
शिवाग्निं जनयित्वा तु सर्वकर्माणे सुव्रत ॥
2.25.m: In the ordinary fire, O fortunate one, are bewitching, driving away, and so on. / But having generated the fire of Śiva for all rites, O one of good vows,

2.25.s:
sapta jihvāḥ prakalpyaiva sarvakāryāṇi kārayet /
athavā sarvakāryāṇi jihvāmātreṇa sidhyati //
2.25.d:
सप्त जिह्वाः प्रकल्प्यैव सर्वकार्याणि कारयेत् ।
अथवा सर्वकार्याणि जिह्वामात्रेण सिध्यति ॥
2.25.m: and having fashioned the seven tongues, one should perform all rites; / or all rites are accomplished merely by a tongue.

2.25.s: śivāgniriti viprendrā jihvāmātreṇa sādhakaḥ //
2.25.d: शिवाग्निरिति विप्रेन्द्रा जिह्वामात्रेण साधकः ॥
2.25.m: The practitioner [accomplishes everything] through the fire of Śiva, O best of brahmins, merely by a tongue.

2.25.s: oṃ bahurūpāyai madhyajihvāyai anekavarṇāyai dakṣiṇottaramadhyagāyai śāntipauṣṭikamokṣādiphalapradāyai svāhā //
2.25.d: ओं बहुरूपायै मध्यजिह्वायै अनेकवर्णायै दक्षिणोत्तरमध्यगायै शान्तिपौष्टिकमोक्षादिफलप्रदायै स्वाहा ॥
2.25.m: Oṃ, svāhā to Bahurūpā, the central tongue of various colours, moving between south and north, bestowing the fruits of appeasement, nourishment, liberation, and so on!

2.25.s: oṃ hiraṇyāyai cāmīkarābhāyai īśānajihvāyai jñānapradāyai svāhā //
2.25.d: ओं हिरण्यायै चामीकराभायै ईशानजिह्वायै ज्ञानप्रदायै स्वाहा ॥
2.25.m: Oṃ, svāhā to Hiraṇyā, shining like gold, the northeast tongue, bestowing knowledge!

2.25.s: oṃ kanakāyai kanakanibhāyai ramyāyai eendrajihvāyai svāhā //
2.25.d: ओं कनकायै कनकनिभायै रम्यायै एएन्द्रजिह्वायै स्वाहा ॥
2.25.m: Oṃ, svāhā to Kanakā, gold-like, charming, the eastern tongue!

2.25.s: oṃ raktāyai raktavarṇāyai āgneyajihvāyai anekavarṇāyai vidveṣaṇamohanāyai svāhā //
2.25.d: ओं रक्तायै रक्तवर्णायै आग्नेयजिह्वायै अनेकवर्णायै विद्वेषणमोहनायै स्वाहा ॥
2.25.m: Oṃ, svāhā to Raktā, red-coloured, the southeast tongue, multi-coloured, causing hatred and delusion!

2.25.s: oṃ kṛṣṇāyai nairṛtajihvāyai māraṇāyai svāhā //
2.25.d: ओं कृष्णायै नैरृतजिह्वायै मारणायै स्वाहा ॥
2.25.m: Oṃ, svāhā to Kṛṣṇā, the southwest tongue, causing death!

2.25.s: oṃ suprabhāyaipaścimajihvāyai muktāphalāyai śāntikāyai pauṣṭikāyai svāhā //
2.25.d: ओं सुप्रभायैपश्चिमजिह्वायै मुक्ताफलायै शान्तिकायै पौष्टिकायै स्वाहा ॥
2.25.m: Oṃ, svāhā to Suprabhā, the western tongue, pearl-like, pacifying and nourishing!

2.25.s: oṃ abhivyaktāyai vāyavyajihvāyai śatrūccāṭanāyai svāhā //
2.25.d: ओं अभिव्यक्तायै वायव्यजिह्वायै शत्रूच्चाटनायै स्वाहा ॥
2.25.m: Oṃ, svāhā to Abhivyaktā, the northwest tongue, driving away enemies!

2.25.s: oṃ vahnaye tejasvine svāhā //
2.25.d: ओं वह्नये तेजस्विने स्वाहा ॥
2.25.m: Oṃ, svāhā to Fire, the radiant one!

2.25.s:
etāvadvahnisaṃskāramathavā vahnikarmasu /
naimittike ca vidhinā śivāgniṃ kārayetpunaḥ //
2.25.d:
एतावद्वह्निसंस्कारमथवा वह्निकर्मसु ।
नैमित्तिके च विधिना शिवाग्निं कारयेत्पुनः ॥
2.25.m: This much is the purification of the fire; or else, in fire rituals / and in occasional rites, one should prepare the fire of Śiva again according to rule.

2.25.s:
nirīkṣaṇaṃ prokṣaṇaṃ tāḍanaṃ ca ṣaṣṭhena phaḍantena abhyukṣaṇaṃ caturthena khananotkiraṇaṃ ṣaṣṭhena pūraṇaṃ samīkaraṇamādyena secanaṃ vauṣaḍantena kṛṭṭanaṃ ṣaṣṭhena saṃmārjanopalepane turīyeṇa kuṇḍaparikalpanaṃ nivṛttyā tribhireva kuṇḍaparidhānaṃ caturthena kuṇḍārcanamādyena rekhācatuṣṭayasapādanaṃ ṣaṣṭhena phaḍantena vajrīkaraṇaṃ catuṣpadāpādanamādyena evaṃ kuṇḍasaṃskāramaṣṭādaśavidham //
kuṇḍasaṃskārānantaramakṣapāṭanaṃ ṣaṣṭhena viṣṭaranyāsamādyena vajrāsane vāgīśvaryāvāhanam//25.67 //
2.25.d:
निरीक्षणं प्रोक्षणं ताडनं च षष्ठेन फडन्तेन अभ्युक्षणं चतुर्थेन खननोत्किरणं षष्ठेन पूरणं समीकरणमाद्येन सेचनं वौषडन्तेन कृट्टनं षष्ठेन संमार्जनोपलेपने तुरीयेण कुण्डपरिकल्पनं निवृत्त्या त्रिभिरेव कुण्डपरिधानं चतुर्थेन कुण्डार्चनमाद्येन रेखाचतुष्टयसपादनं षष्ठेन फडन्तेन वज्रीकरणं चतुष्पदापादनमाद्येन एवं कुण्डसंस्कारमष्टादशविधम् ॥
कुण्डसंस्कारानन्तरमक्षपाटनं षष्ठेन विष्टरन्यासमाद्येन वज्रासने वागीश्वर्यावाहनम्॥25.67 ॥
2.25.m:
Gazing, sprinkling, and striking are done with the sixth mantra ending in phaṭ; besprinkling with the fourth; digging and casting out with the sixth; filling and levelling with the first; moistening with that ending in vauṣaṭ; beating with the sixth; sweeping and smearing with the fourth; fashioning the fire-pit with nivṛtti and the three; enclosing the fire-pit with the fourth; worship of the fire-pit with the first; drawing the four lines with the sixth ending in phaṭ; adamantine protection and establishing the four-legged seat with the first: thus is the eighteen-fold purification of the fire-pit.

After the purification of the fire-pit, opening the eyes is done with the sixth; the laying of the seat with the first; [and] the invocation of Vāgīśvarī on the adamantine seat.

2.25.s:
oṃ hrīṃ vāgīśvarīṃ śyāmavarṇāṃ viśālākṣīṃ yauvanonmattavigrahām /
ṛtumatīṃ vāgīśvaraśaktimāvāhayāmi //
2.25.d:
ओं ह्रीं वागीश्वरीं श्यामवर्णां विशालाक्षीं यौवनोन्मत्तविग्रहाम् ।
ऋतुमतीं वागीश्वरशक्तिमावाहयामि ॥
2.25.m: Oṃ hrīm, I invoke Vāgīśvarī, dark-coloured, large-eyed, her form intoxicated with youth, in her fertile season, the śakti of Vāgīśvara!

2.25.s: vāgīśvarīṃ pūjayāmi //
2.25.d: वागीश्वरीं पूजयामि ॥

2.25.s:
roṃ iṃ vāgīśvarāya namaḥ /
āvāhanasthāpanasannidhānasannirodhapūjāntaṃ vāgīśvarīṃ saṃbhāvya garbhādhānavahnisaṃskāram //
2.25.d:
रों इं वागीश्वराय नमः ।
आवाहनस्थापनसन्निधानसन्निरोधपूजान्तं वागीश्वरीं संभाव्य गर्भाधानवह्निसंस्कारम् ॥
2.25.m: Oṃ im, obeisance to Vāgīśvara! / Having visualised Vāgīśvarī up to invocation, establishing, presence, containment, and worship, [there is] the fire purification of conception.

2.25.s: ekavaktraṃ caturbhujaṃ śuddhasphaṭikābhaṃ varadābhayahastaṃ paraśumṛgadharaṃ jaṭāmukuṭamaṇḍitaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitamāvāhayāmi //
2.25.d: एकवक्त्रं चतुर्भुजं शुद्धस्फटिकाभं वरदाभयहस्तं परशुमृगधरं जटामुकुटमण्डितं सर्वाभरणभूषितमावाहयामि ॥
2.25.m: I invoke the single-faced, four-armed one, glowing like pure crystal, hands granting boons and fearlessness, holding an axe and a deer, adorned with a crown of matted hair, decorated with all ornaments.

2.25.s:
roṃ iṃ vāgīśvarāya namaḥ /
āvāhanasthāpanasannidhānasannirodhapūjāntaṃ vāgīśvarīṃ saṃbhāvya garbhādhānavahnisaṃskāram //
2.25.d:
रों इं वागीश्वराय नमः ।
आवाहनस्थापनसन्निधानसन्निरोधपूजान्तं वागीश्वरीं संभाव्य गर्भाधानवह्निसंस्कारम् ॥
2.25.m: Oṃ im, obeisance to Vāgīśvara! / Having visualised Vāgīśvarī up to invocation, establishing, presence, containment, and worship, [there is] the fire purification of conception.

2.25.s: araṇījanitaṃ kāntodbhavaṃvā agnihotrajaṃvā tāmrapātreśarāvevā ānīya nirīkṣaṇatāḍanābhyukṣaṇaprakṣālanamādyenakravyādāśivaparityāgopi prathamena vahnestraikāraṇaṃ jaṭharabhrūmadyādāvāhyagniṃ vaikāraṇamūrtāvāgneyena uddīpanamādyena puraṣeṇa saṃhitayā dhāraṇā dhenumudrāṃ turīyeṇāvaguṇṭhya jānubhyāmavaniṃ gatvā śarāvotthāpanaṃ kuṇḍopari nidhāya pradakṣiṇamāvartya turīyeṇātmasammukhāṃ vāgīśvarīṃ garbhanāḍyāṃ garbhādhānāntarīyeṇa kamalapradānamādyena vauṣaḍantena kuśārghyaṃ dattvā indhanapradānamādyena prajvālanaṃ garbhādhānaṃ casadyenādyena pūjanaṃ vāmena pūjanaṃ dvitīyena sīmantonnayanamaghoreṇatṛtīyena pūjanam //
2.25.d: अरणीजनितं कान्तोद्भवंवा अग्निहोत्रजंवा ताम्रपात्रेशरावेवा आनीय निरीक्षणताडनाभ्युक्षणप्रक्षालनमाद्येनक्रव्यादाशिवपरित्यागोपि प्रथमेन वह्नेस्त्रैकारणं जठरभ्रूमद्यादावाह्यग्निं वैकारणमूर्तावाग्नेयेन उद्दीपनमाद्येन पुरषेण संहितया धारणा धेनुमुद्रां तुरीयेणावगुण्ठ्य जानुभ्यामवनिं गत्वा शरावोत्थापनं कुण्डोपरि निधाय प्रदक्षिणमावर्त्य तुरीयेणात्मसम्मुखां वागीश्वरीं गर्भनाड्यां गर्भाधानान्तरीयेण कमलप्रदानमाद्येन वौषडन्तेन कुशार्घ्यं दत्त्वा इन्धनप्रदानमाद्येन प्रज्वालनं गर्भाधानं चसद्येनाद्येन पूजनं वामेन पूजनं द्वितीयेन सीमन्तोन्नयनमघोरेणतृतीयेन पूजनम् ॥
2.25.m: Having brought [fire] produced from churning sticks, born from a sun-gem, or from the Agnihotra, in a copper vessel or a shallow bowl, gazing, striking, besprinkling, and washing are done with the first mantra; discarding the flesh-eating, inauspicious portion is also with the first; the threefold division of fire; having invoked the fire from the belly and between the eyebrows into the manifest form with the mantra of Agni; rekindling with the first; retention by Puruṣa with the Saṃhitā; veiling with the cow-gesture with the fourth; having touched the earth with the knees, lifting the shallow bowl, placing it upon the fire-pit, turning it clockwise; facing Vāgīśvarī towards oneself with the fourth; within the tubular channel of the womb, between the acts of conception, offering a lotus with the first ending in vauṣaṭ; having offered the kuśa-water oblation, offering firewood with the first; the kindling, and conception with Sadyojāta; worship with the first; worship with Vāmadeva; the parting of the hair with the second; worship with Aghora, with the third;

2.25.s: avayavavyāptiktrodanaṃ vaktraniṣkṛtiriti tṛtīyena garbhajātakarmapuruṣeṇa pūjanaṃ turīyema ṣaṣṭhena prokṣaṇaṃ sūtakaśuddhaye cāgnisūnurakṣākusāstreṇa vaktreṇāgnau mūlamīsāgraṃ nairṛtimūlaṃ vāyavyāgraṃ vāyavyamūlamīśāgramiti kuśāstaramamitipūrvoktamidhmamagramūlaghṛtāktaṃ lālāpanodāya ṣaṣṭhena juhuyāt //
2.25.d: अवयवव्याप्तिक्त्रोदनं वक्त्रनिष्कृतिरिति तृतीयेन गर्भजातकर्मपुरुषेण पूजनं तुरीयेम षष्ठेन प्रोक्षणं सूतकशुद्धये चाग्निसूनुरक्षाकुसास्त्रेण वक्त्रेणाग्नौ मूलमीसाग्रं नैरृतिमूलं वायव्याग्रं वायव्यमूलमीशाग्रमिति कुशास्तरममितिपूर्वोक्तमिध्ममग्रमूलघृताक्तं लालापनोदाय षष्ठेन जुहुयात् ॥
2.25.m: pervasion of limbs, the crying, the cleansing of the mouth with the third; the birth-rites of the embryo, worship with Puruṣa with the fourth; sprinkling with the sixth for purification from natal impurity; and protecting the son of fire with the kuśa-weapon; [laying the kuśa] by mouth in the fire, base to the north-east, tip to the south-west, base to the north-west, tip to the north-east: this is the bed of kuśa; one should offer with the sixth [mantra] the previously mentioned firewood smeared with ghee at the tip and base, to remove saliva.

2.25.s: pañcapūrvātikrameṇa paridhiviṣṭaranyāso 'pi ādyena viṣṭaropari hiraṇyagarbhaharanārāyaṇānapi pūjayet //
2.25.d: पञ्चपूर्वातिक्रमेण परिधिविष्टरन्यासो ऽपि आद्येन विष्टरोपरि हिरण्यगर्भहरनारायणानपि पूजयेत् ॥
2.25.m: Passing over the previous five, the placement of the boundary sticks and seat is also with the first; upon the seat, one should also worship Hiraṇyagarbha, Hara, and Nārāyaṇa.

2.25.s: indrādilokapālāṃśca pūjayet //
2.25.d: इन्द्रादिलोकपालांश्च पूजयेत् ॥
2.25.m: And one should worship the world-guardians headed by Indra.

2.25.s: vajrāvartaparyantānapi pūjayet //
2.25.d: वज्रावर्तपर्यन्तानपि पूजयेत् ॥
2.25.m: One should also worship [those] ending with the Vajrāvarta.

2.25.s: vāgīśvaravāgīśvarīpūjādyenamudvāsya hutaṃ visarjayet //
2.25.d: वागीश्वरवागीश्वरीपूजाद्येनमुद्वास्य हुतं विसर्जयेत् ॥
2.25.m: Having dispatched [the deity] with the worship of Vāgīśvara and Vāgīśvarī and the rest, one should dismiss the oblation.

2.25.s: sraksruvasaṃskāramatho nirīkṣaṇaprokṣamatāḍanābhyukṣaṇādīni pūrvavat srak sruvaṃ ca hastadvaye gṛhītvā saṃsthāpanamādyena tāḍanamapi sruksruvopari darbhānulekhanamūlamadyamāgreṇa tritvena srakśākti sruvamapi śaṃbhuṃ dakṣiṇapārśve kuśopari śaktaye namaḥ śaṃbhave namaḥ //
2.25.d: स्रक्स्रुवसंस्कारमथो निरीक्षणप्रोक्षमताडनाभ्युक्षणादीनि पूर्ववत् स्रक् स्रुवं च हस्तद्वये गृहीत्वा संस्थापनमाद्येन ताडनमपि स्रुक्स्रुवोपरि दर्भानुलेखनमूलमद्यमाग्रेण त्रित्वेन स्रक्शाक्ति स्रुवमपि शंभुं दक्षिणपार्श्वे कुशोपरि शक्तये नमः शंभवे नमः ॥
2.25.m: Now the consecration of the sruc and sruva ladles: inspecting, sprinkling, striking, and besprinkling as before; taking the sruc and sruva in both hands; placing [them] with the first [mantra]; striking also; drawing a darbha grass line over the sruc and sruva, root with the first, tip with the three-part [mantra]; [visualising] the sruc as Śakti and the sruva as Śambhu, on the right side upon kuśa grass: 'Obeisance to Śakti, obeisance to Śambhu.'

2.25.s: tato hyantisūtreṇa sruksruvau turīyema veṣṭayedarcayecca //
2.25.d: ततो ह्यन्तिसूत्रेण स्रुक्स्रुवौ तुरीयेम वेष्टयेदर्चयेच्च ॥
2.25.m: Then indeed, one should bind the sruc and sruva with the end-cord using the fourth [mantra] and worship [them].

2.25.s: dhenumudrāṃ darśāyitvā turīyeṇāvaguṇṭhya ṣaṣṭhena rakṣāṃ vidhāya sruksruvasaṃskāraḥ pūrvamevoktaḥ //
2.25.d: धेनुमुद्रां दर्शायित्वा तुरीयेणावगुण्ठ्य षष्ठेन रक्षां विधाय स्रुक्स्रुवसंस्कारः पूर्वमेवोक्तः ॥
2.25.m: Displaying the dhenumudrā, veiling with the fourth [mantra], and making protection with the sixth [mantra]—the consecration of the sruc and sruva has been taught before.

2.25.s: punarājyasaṃskāraḥ pūrvemevoktaḥ nirīkṣaṇaprokṣaṇatāḍanābhukṣaṇādīni pūrvavat //
2.25.d: पुनराज्यसंस्कारः पूर्वेमेवोक्तः निरीक्षणप्रोक्षणताडनाभुक्षणादीनि पूर्ववत् ॥
2.25.m: Next the consecration of the clarified butter has been taught before: inspecting, sprinkling, striking, and besprinkling as before;

2.25.s: ājyapratāpanamaiśānyāṃ vā ṣaṣṭhena vedyupari vinyasya ghṛtapātraṃ vitastimātraṃ kuśapavitraṃ vāmahastāṅguṣṭhānāmikāgraṃ gṛhītvā dakṣiṇāṅguṣṭhānāmikāmūlaṃ gṛhītvāgnijvālotpavanaṃ svāhāntena turīyeṇa punaḥ ṣaḍ darbhān gṛhītvā pūrvavatsvātmasaṃplavanaṃ svahāntenādyena kuśadvayapavitrabandhanaṃ cādyenaghṛte nyasediti pavitrīkaraṇam //
2.25.d: आज्यप्रतापनमैशान्यां वा षष्ठेन वेद्युपरि विन्यस्य घृतपात्रं वितस्तिमात्रं कुशपवित्रं वामहस्ताङ्गुष्ठानामिकाग्रं गृहीत्वा दक्षिणाङ्गुष्ठानामिकामूलं गृहीत्वाग्निज्वालोत्पवनं स्वाहान्तेन तुरीयेण पुनः षड् दर्भान् गृहीत्वा पूर्ववत्स्वात्मसंप्लवनं स्वहान्तेनाद्येन कुशद्वयपवित्रबन्धनं चाद्येनघृते न्यसेदिति पवित्रीकरणम् ॥
2.25.m: heating the clarified butter, or placing the butter vessel on the altar in the northeast with the sixth [mantra]; taking a kuśa-pavitra a span long with the tip of the left thumb and ring finger; taking the root of it with the right thumb and ring finger; purifying by the fire flame with the fourth [mantra] ending in svāhā; again taking six darbhas and purifying oneself as before with the first [mantra] ending in svāhā; tying the strainer of two kuśa blades and placing it into the clarified butter with the first [mantra]—this is the purification.

2.25.s:
darbhadvayaṃ pragṛhyāgniprajvālanaṃ ghṛtaṃ tridhā vartayet /
saṃprokṣyāgnau nidhāpayediti nīrājanam //
2.25.d:
दर्भद्वयं प्रगृह्याग्निप्रज्वालनं घृतं त्रिधा वर्तयेत् ।
संप्रोक्ष्याग्नौ निधापयेदिति नीराजनम् ॥
2.25.m: Taking two blades of darbha grass and igniting the fire, one should circulate the clarified butter three times, / sprinkle it, and place it in the fire: this is the waving of lights [nīrājana].

2.25.s: punardarbhān gṛhītvā kīṭakādi nirīkṣyārghyeṇa saṃprokṣya darbhānagnau nidhāya ityavadyotanam //
2.25.d: पुनर्दर्भान् गृहीत्वा कीटकादि निरीक्ष्यार्घ्येण संप्रोक्ष्य दर्भानग्नौ निधाय इत्यवद्योतनम् ॥
2.25.m: Again taking darbha blades, inspecting for insects and the like, sprinkling with arghya water, and placing the darbha blades in the fire: this is the illumination [avadyotana].

2.25.s: darbhadvayaṃ gṛhītvāgnijvālayā ghṛtaṃ nirīkṣayet //
2.25.d: दर्भद्वयं गृहीत्वाग्निज्वालया घृतं निरीक्षयेत् ॥
2.25.m: Taking two darbha blades, one should inspect the clarified butter by the flame of the fire.

2.25.s: darbheṇa gṛhītvā tenāgradvayena śuklapakṣadvayenādyeneti kṛṣṇapakṣasaṃpātanaṃ ghṛtaṃ tribhāgena vibhajya sruveṇaikabhāgenājyenāgnayesvāhā dvitīyenājyena somāya svāhā ājyena oṃ agnīṣomābhyāṃ svāhā ājyenāgnaye sviṣṭakṛte svāhā //
2.25.d: दर्भेण गृहीत्वा तेनाग्रद्वयेन शुक्लपक्षद्वयेनाद्येनेति कृष्णपक्षसंपातनं घृतं त्रिभागेन विभज्य स्रुवेणैकभागेनाज्येनाग्नयेस्वाहा द्वितीयेनाज्येन सोमाय स्वाहा आज्येन ओं अग्नीषोमाभ्यां स्वाहा आज्येनाग्नये स्विष्टकृते स्वाहा ॥
2.25.m: Taking [butter] with a darbha blade, with the two tips, with the two fortnights, the bright [and dark], with the first [mantra], pouring during the dark fortnight; dividing the clarified butter into three parts: with one part of clarified butter by the sruva, 'Svāhā to Agni'; with the second clarified butter, 'Svāhā to Soma'; with clarified butter, 'Oṃ svāhā to Agni-Soma'; with clarified butter, 'Svāhā to Agni Sviṣṭakṛt.'

2.25.s: punaḥ kuśena gṛhītvā saṃhitābhimantreṇa namontenābhimantrayet //
2.25.d: पुनः कुशेन गृहीत्वा संहिताभिमन्त्रेण नमोन्तेनाभिमन्त्रयेत् ॥
2.25.m: Again taking with kuśa grass, one should consecrate it with the Saṃhitā-mantra ending in namaḥ.

2.25.s:
abhimantrya denumudrāpradarśanakavacāvaguṇṭhanāstreṇa rakṣām /
atha saṃskṛte nidhāpayet ājyasaṃskāraḥ //
2.25.d:
अभिमन्त्र्य देनुमुद्राप्रदर्शनकवचावगुण्ठनास्त्रेण रक्षाम् ।
अथ संस्कृते निधापयेत् आज्यसंस्कारः ॥
2.25.m: Having consecrated it, showing the dhenumudrā, veiling with the kavaca, and protecting with the astra [mantra]; / then one should place it in the consecrated [place]—this is the consecration of the clarified butter.

2.25.s:
ājyena mrugvadanena cakraābhighāraṇaṃ śaktibījādiśānamūrtaye svāhā /
pūrvavatpuruṣavattrāya svāhā aghorahṛdayāyasvāhā vāmadevāya guhyāya svāhā sadyojātamūrtaye svāhā /
iti vaktrodghāṭanam //
2.25.d:
आज्येन म्रुग्वदनेन चक्रआभिघारणं शक्तिबीजादिशानमूर्तये स्वाहा ।
पूर्ववत्पुरुषवत्त्राय स्वाहा अघोरहृदयायस्वाहा वामदेवाय गुह्याय स्वाहा सद्योजातमूर्तये स्वाहा ।
इति वक्त्रोद्घाटनम् ॥
2.25.m: With clarified butter, with the deer-face [mudrā], sprinkling the circle: 'Svāhā to the form of Īśāna with the śaktibīja'; / as before, 'Svāhā to Puruṣa-Vaktra', 'Svāhā to Aghora-Hṛdaya', 'Svāhā to Vāmadeva-Guhya', 'Svāhā to Sadyojāta-Mūrti'— / this is the opening of the mouths.

2.25.s:
īśānamūrtaye tatpuruṣavaktrāya svāhā tatpuruṣavaktrāya aghorahṛdayāya svāhā aghorahṛdayāya vāmaguhyāya sadyojatamūrtaye svāhā iti vaktrasaṃdhānam //
īśānamūrtaye tatpuruṣāya vaktrāya aghorahṛdayāya vāmadevāya guhyā sadyojātāya svāhā iti vaktrasaṃdhānam //
2.25.d:
ईशानमूर्तये तत्पुरुषवक्त्राय स्वाहा तत्पुरुषवक्त्राय अघोरहृदयाय स्वाहा अघोरहृदयाय वामगुह्याय सद्योजतमूर्तये स्वाहा इति वक्त्रसंधानम् ॥
ईशानमूर्तये तत्पुरुषाय वक्त्राय अघोरहृदयाय वामदेवाय गुह्या सद्योजाताय स्वाहा इति वक्त्रसंधानम् ॥
2.25.m:
'Svāhā to the form of Īśāna, to the face of Tatpuruṣa'; 'Svāhā to the face of Tatpuruṣa, to the heart of Aghora'; 'Svāhā to the heart of Aghora, to the secret of Vāma, to the form of Sadyojāta'—this is the joining of the mouths. / 'Svāhā to the form of Īśāna, to Tatpuruṣa, to the face, to the heart of Aghora, to Vāmadeva, to the secret, to Sadyojāta'—this is the joining of the mouths.

'Svāhā to the form of Īśāna, to Tatpuruṣa, to the face, to the heart of Aghora, to Vāmadeva, to the secret, to the form of Sadyojāta'—this is the unification of the mouths.

2.25.s: īśānamūrtaye tatpuruṣāya vaktrāya aghorahṛdayāya vāmadevāya guhyāya sadyojātamūrtaye svāhā iti vaktraikyakaraṇam //
2.25.d: ईशानमूर्तये तत्पुरुषाय वक्त्राय अघोरहृदयाय वामदेवाय गुह्याय सद्योजातमूर्तये स्वाहा इति वक्त्रैक्यकरणम् ॥

2.25.s:
śivāgniṃ janayitvaivaṃ sarvakarmāṇi kārayet /
kevalaṃ jihvayā vāpi śāntikādyāni sarvadā //
2.25.d:
शिवाग्निं जनयित्वैवं सर्वकर्माणि कारयेत् ।
केवलं जिह्वया वापि शान्तिकाद्यानि सर्वदा ॥
2.25.m: Having thus generated the Śiva-fire, one should perform all rites, / or solely with the tongue [of fire], always [rites] such as pacification.

2.25.s:
garbhādhānādikāryeṣu vahneḥ pratyekamavyaya /
daśa āhutāyo deyā yonibījena pañcadhā //
2.25.d:
गर्भाधानादिकार्येषु वह्नेः प्रत्येकमव्यय ।
दश आहुतायो देया योनिबीजेन पञ्चधा ॥
2.25.m: In rites such as the conception ceremony of the fire, O imperishable one, / ten oblations are to be given individually with the yoni-bīja fivefold.

2.25.s:
śivāgnau kalpayeddivyaṃ pūrvavatparamāsanam /
āvāhanaṃ tathā nyāsaṃ yathā deve tathārcanam //
2.25.d:
शिवाग्नौ कल्पयेद्दिव्यं पूर्ववत्परमासनम् ।
आवाहनं तथा न्यासं यथा देवे तथार्चनम् ॥
2.25.m: In the Śiva-fire one should arrange the divine, supreme seat as before; / invocation and nyāsa likewise, and worship as for the God.

2.25.s:
mūlamantraṃ sakṛjjaptvā devadevaṃ pramamya ca /
prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā sagarbhaṃ sarvasaṃmatam //
2.25.d:
मूलमन्त्रं सकृज्जप्त्वा देवदेवं प्रमम्य च ।
प्राणायामत्रयं कृत्वा सगर्भं सर्वसंमतम् ॥
2.25.m: Chanting the root mantra once and bowing to the God of gods, / having performed three prāṇāyāmas with the seed syllable [sagarbha], agreed upon by all;

2.25.s:
paripecanapūrvaṃ ca tadidhmamabhigārya ca /
juhuyādagnimadhye tu jvalite 'tha mahāmune //
2.25.d:
परिपेचनपूर्वं च तदिध्ममभिगार्य च ।
जुहुयादग्निमध्ये तु ज्वलिते ऽथ महामुने ॥
2.25.m: preceded by circum-sprinkling, and sprinkling that fuel wood, / one should offer oblations into the middle of the fire when it blazes, O great sage.

2.25.s:
āghārāvapi cādhāya cājyenaiva tu ṣaṇmuke /
ājyabhāgau tu juhuyādvidhinaiva ghṛtena ca //
2.25.d:
आघारावपि चाधाय चाज्येनैव तु षण्मुके ।
आज्यभागौ तु जुहुयाद्विधिनैव घृतेन च ॥
2.25.m: Having placed the two continuous libations [āghāra] with clarified butter in the six-faced [fire], / one should offer the two portions of clarified butter according to rule with ghee.

2.25.s:
cakṣuṣī cājyabhāgau tu cāgnaye ca tathottare /
ātmano dakṣiṇe caiva somāyeti dvijottama //
2.25.d:
चक्षुषी चाज्यभागौ तु चाग्नये च तथोत्तरे ।
आत्मनो दक्षिणे चैव सोमायेति द्विजोत्तम ॥
2.25.m: The two eyes and the two portions of clarified butter: to Agni in the north, / and to Soma on one's right, O best of the twice-born.

2.25.s:
pratyaṅmukhasya devasya śivāgnerbrahmaṇaḥ suta /
akṣi vai dakṣiṇaṃ caiva cottaraṃ cottaraṃ tathā //
2.25.d:
प्रत्यङ्मुखस्य देवस्य शिवाग्नेर्ब्रह्मणः सुत ।
अक्षि वै दक्षिणं चैव चोत्तरं चोत्तरं तथा ॥
2.25.m: For the God facing west, the Śiva-fire, O son of Brahmā, / the right eye is [to Agni] and the northern is [to Soma] likewise;

2.25.s:
dakṣiṇaṃ tu mahābhāga bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ /
ājyenāhutayastatra mūlenaiva daśaiva tu //
2.25.d:
दक्षिणं तु महाभाग भवत्येव न संशयः ।
आज्येनाहुतयस्तत्र मूलेनैव दशैव तु ॥
2.25.m: the right one indeed, O fortunate one, [is Agni's], there is no doubt. / Ten oblations [are to be made] there with clarified butter solely using the root mantra;

2.25.s:
caruṇā ca yathāvaddhi samidbhiśca tathā smṛtam /
pūrṇāhutiṃ tato dadyānmūlamantreṇa suvrata //
2.25.d:
चरुणा च यथावद्धि समिद्भिश्च तथा स्मृतम् ।
पूर्णाहुतिं ततो दद्यान्मूलमन्त्रेण सुव्रत ॥
2.25.m: with the caru offering as prescribed, and likewise with firewood sticks, it is taught. / Then one should offer the final full oblation with the root mantra, O one of good vows.

2.25.s:
sarvāvaraṇadevānāṃ pañcapañcaiva pūrvavat /
īśānādikrameṇaiva śaktibījakrameṇa ca //
2.25.d:
सर्वावरणदेवानां पञ्चपञ्चैव पूर्ववत् ।
ईशानादिक्रमेणैव शक्तिबीजक्रमेण च ॥
2.25.m: Five [oblations] each for all the retinue deities, as before, / in the order beginning with Īśāna and in the order of the śaktibījas.

2.25.s:
prāyāścittamagoreṇa sveṣṭāntaṃ pūrvavatsmṛtam /
triprakāraṃ mayā proktamagnikāryaṃ suśobhanam //
2.25.d:
प्रायाश्चित्तमगोरेण स्वेष्टान्तं पूर्ववत्स्मृतम् ।
त्रिप्रकारं मया प्रोक्तमग्निकार्यं सुशोभनम् ॥
2.25.m: The expiation with the Aghora [mantra] up to one's chosen [deity] is taught as before. / The threefold, very auspicious fire ritual has been declared by me.

2.25.s:
yatāvasaramevaṃ hi kuryānnityaṃ mahāmune /
jīvitānte labhetsvargaṃ labhete agnihīpanam //
2.25.d:
यतावसरमेवं हि कुर्यान्नित्यं महामुने ।
जीवितान्ते लभेत्स्वर्गं लभेते अग्निहीपनम् ॥
2.25.m: As opportunity permits, one should perform this daily, O great sage; / at the end of life one attains heaven, one attains the rekindling of the sacred fire.

2.25.s:
narakaṃ caiva nāpnoti yasya kasyāpi karmaṇaḥ /
ahiṃsakaṃ careddhomaṃ sādhako muktikāṅkṣakaḥ //
2.25.d:
नरकं चैव नाप्नोति यस्य कस्यापि कर्मणः ।
अहिंसकं चरेद्धोमं साधको मुक्तिकाङ्क्षकः ॥
2.25.m: And he does not go to hell from whatever action [he may have done]. / The practitioner desiring liberation should perform a non-injurious homa.

2.25.s:
hṛdisthaṃ cintayedagniṃ dhyānayajñena homayet /
dehasthaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ śivaṃ sarvajagatpatim //
2.25.d:
हृदिस्थं चिन्तयेदग्निं ध्यानयज्ञेन होमयेत् ।
देहस्थं सर्वभूतानां शिवं सर्वजगत्पतिम् ॥
2.25.m: One should meditate on the fire dwelling in the heart, and make offering through the sacrifice of meditation / to Śiva, the Lord of the entire world, dwelling within the bodies of all beings.

2.25.s:
taṃ jñātvā homayedbhaktyā prāṇāyāmena nityaśaḥ /
bāhyahomapradātā tu pāṣāṇe darduro bhavet //
iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge pañcaviṃśatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
2.25.d:
तं ज्ञात्वा होमयेद्भक्त्या प्राणायामेन नित्यशः ।
बाह्यहोमप्रदाता तु पाषाणे दर्दुरो भवेत् ॥
इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे उत्तरभागे पञ्चविंशतितमो ऽध्यायः
2.25.m:
Knowing him, one should make offering with devotion through prāṇāyāma perpetually. / But a giver of external homa becomes a frog in a stone.

Thus ends the twenty-fifth chapter in the second part of the glorious Liṅga Mahāpurāṇa.

2.26.s:
śailādiruvāca
athavā devamīśānaṃ liṅge saṃpūjayecchivam /
brāhmaṇaḥ śivabhaktaśca śivadhyānaparāyaṇaḥ //
2.26.d:
शैलादिरुवाच
अथवा देवमीशानं लिङ्गे संपूजयेच्छिवम् ।
ब्राह्मणः शिवभक्तश्च शिवध्यानपरायणः ॥
2.26.m: The son of Śilāda said: / Or else, a brāhmaṇa devoted to Śiva and intent on meditation on Śiva / should worship the God, Īśāna, Śiva, in the liṅga.

2.26.s:
agnirityādinā bhasma gṛhītvā hyagnihotrajam /
uddhūlayeddhi sarvāṅgamāpādatalamastakam //
2.26.d:
अग्निरित्यादिना भस्म गृहीत्वा ह्यग्निहोत्रजम् ।
उद्धूलयेद्धि सर्वाङ्गमापादतलमस्तकम् ॥
2.26.m: Taking the sacred ash born of the agnihotra with [the mantra beginning with] 'Agniḥ' and the rest, / he should indeed smear all his limbs from the soles of the feet to the head.

2.26.s:
ācāmedbrahmatīrthena brahmasūtrī hyudaṅmukhaḥ /
athoṃnamaḥ śivāyeti tanuṃ kṛtvātmanaḥ punaḥ //
2.26.d:
आचामेद्ब्रह्मतीर्थेन ब्रह्मसूत्री ह्युदङ्मुखः ।
अथोंनमः शिवायेति तनुं कृत्वात्मनः पुनः ॥
2.26.m: Wearing the sacred thread and facing north, he should sip water via the brahma-tīrtha; / then, having made his body anew with 'Oṃ namaḥ śivāya',

2.26.s:
devaṃ ca tena mantreṇa pūjayetpraṇavena ca /
sarvasmādadhikā pūjā aghoreśasya śūlinaḥ //
2.26.d:
देवं च तेन मन्त्रेण पूजयेत्प्रणवेन च ।
सर्वस्मादधिका पूजा अघोरेशस्य शूलिनः ॥
2.26.m: he should worship the God with that mantra and with the praṇava. / Higher than all is the worship of the trident-bearing Lord of Aghora.

2.26.s:
sāmānyaṃ yajanaṃ sarvamagnikāryaṃ ca suvrata /
mantrabhedaḥ prabhostasya aghoradhyānameva ca //
2.26.d:
सामान्यं यजनं सर्वमग्निकार्यं च सुव्रत ।
मन्त्रभेदः प्रभोस्तस्य अघोरध्यानमेव च ॥
2.26.m: All the ordinary worship and the fire ritual [are the same], O one of good vows; / the variation is only in the mantra of that Lord and the meditation on Aghora.

2.26.s:
mantraḥ
aghorebhyo 'tha ghorebhyo ghoraghoratarebhyaḥ śarvebhyaḥ sarvaśarvebhyo namaste astu rudrarūpebhyaḥ //
2.26.d:
मन्त्रः
अघोरेभ्यो ऽथ घोरेभ्यो घोरघोरतरेभ्यः शर्वेभ्यः सर्वशर्वेभ्यो नमस्ते अस्तु रुद्ररूपेभ्यः ॥
2.26.m: The mantra: / 'To the non-terrific, and to the terrific, and to the terribly terrific, to Śarva, to all forms of Śarva: obeisance be to you who have the form of Rudra!'

2.26.s:
aghorebhyaḥ praśāntahṛdayāya namaḥ /
atha ghorebhyaḥ sarvātmabrahmaśirase svāhā /
ghoraghoratarebhyaḥ jvālāmālinī śikāyai vaṣaṭ /
sarvebhyaḥ sarvaśarvebhyaḥ piṅgalakavacāya hum /
namaste astu rudrarūpebhyaḥ netratrayāya vaṣaṭ /
sahasrākṣāya durbhedāya pāśupatāstrāya huṃ phaṭ /
snātvācāmya tanuṃ kṛtvā samabhyukṣyāgamarṣaṇam /
tarpaṇaṃ vidhinā cārghyaṃ bhānave bhānupūjanam //
2.26.d:
अघोरेभ्यः प्रशान्तहृदयाय नमः ।
अथ घोरेभ्यः सर्वात्मब्रह्मशिरसे स्वाहा ।
घोरघोरतरेभ्यः ज्वालामालिनी शिकायै वषट् ।
सर्वेभ्यः सर्वशर्वेभ्यः पिङ्गलकवचाय हुम् ।
नमस्ते अस्तु रुद्ररूपेभ्यः नेत्रत्रयाय वषट् ।
सहस्राक्षाय दुर्भेदाय पाशुपतास्त्राय हुं फट् ।
स्नात्वाचाम्य तनुं कृत्वा समभ्युक्ष्यागमर्षणम् ।
तर्पणं विधिना चार्घ्यं भानवे भानुपूजनम् ॥
2.26.m: "Obeisance to the non-terrific ones (aghorebhyaḥ), to the tranquil heart, namaḥ. / Svāhā to the terrific ones (atha ghorebhyaḥ), to the head of Brahman that is the Self of all. / Vaṣaṭ to the most extremely terrific ones (ghoraghoratarebhyaḥ), to the crest-lock garlanded with flames. / Hum to all, to all the Śarvas (śarvebhyaḥ sarvaśarvebhyaḥ), to the reddish-brown armour. / Vaṣaṭ: Obeisance be to you, O forms of Rudra (namaste astu rudrarūpebhyaḥ), to the three eyes. / Huṃ phaṭ to the thousand-eyed, the impenetrable, the Pāśupata weapon." / Having bathed, sipped water, purified the body, sprinkled oneself, [recited] the Aghamarṣaṇa hymn, / [performed] libation according to rule, offered water (arghya) to the sun, and worshipped the sun,

2.26.s:
samaṃ cāghorapūjāyāṃ mantramātreṇa bheditam /
mārgaśuddhistathā dvāri pūjāṃ vāstvadhipasya ca //
2.26.d:
समं चाघोरपूजायां मन्त्रमात्रेण भेदितम् ।
मार्गशुद्धिस्तथा द्वारि पूजां वास्त्वधिपस्य च ॥
2.26.m: everything is identical in the worship of Aghora, differentiated only by mantra. / Likewise, having performed purification of the path, and at the doorway, worship of the lord of the site,

2.26.s:
kṛtvā karaṃ viśodhyāgre sa śubhāsanamāsthitaḥ /
nāsāgrakamale sthāpya dagdhākṣaḥ kṣubhikāgninā //
2.26.d:
कृत्वा करं विशोध्याग्रे स शुभासनमास्थितः ।
नासाग्रकमले स्थाप्य दग्धाक्षः क्षुभिकाग्निना ॥
2.26.m: having purified his hands in front, seated on an auspicious seat, / placing [his attention] on the lotus of the tip of the nose, with eyes burned by the fire of agitation,

2.26.s:
vāyunā prerya tadbhasma viśodhya ca śubhāṃ bhasā /
śaktyāmṛtamaye brahmakalāṃ tatra prakalpayet //
2.26.d:
वायुना प्रेर्य तद्भस्म विशोध्य च शुभां भसा ।
शक्त्यामृतमये ब्रह्मकलां तत्र प्रकल्पयेत् ॥
2.26.m: driving that ash away with the wind, purifying it with auspicious water, / he should project the part of Brahman (brahmakalā) into the nectar-like energy there.

2.26.s:
aghoraṃ pañcadhā kṛtvā pañcāṅgasahitaṃ punaḥ /
itthaṃ jñānākriyāmevaṃ vinyasya ca vidhānataḥ //
2.26.d:
अघोरं पञ्चधा कृत्वा पञ्चाङ्गसहितं पुनः ।
इत्थं ज्ञानाक्रियामेवं विन्यस्य च विधानतः ॥
2.26.m: Having arranged Aghora into five parts, together with the five limbs again, / thus having performed the placement (nyāsa) of knowledge and action in accordance with rule,

2.26.s:
nyāsāstrinetrasahito hṛdi dhyātvā varāsane /
nābhau vahnigataṃ smṛtvā bhrūmadhye dīpavatprabhum //
2.26.d:
न्यासास्त्रिनेत्रसहितो हृदि ध्यात्वा वरासने ।
नाभौ वह्निगतं स्मृत्वा भ्रूमध्ये दीपवत्प्रभुम् ॥
2.26.m: having meditated on him in the heart with three eyes upon an excellent seat during the nyāsa, / having remembered him in the navel as abiding in fire, and between the eyebrows as a lamp-like lord,

2.26.s:
sāṃtyā bījāṅkurānantadharmādyairapi saṃyute /
somasūryāgnisaṃpanne mūrtitrayasamanvite //
2.26.d:
सांत्या बीजाङ्कुरानन्तधर्माद्यैरपि संयुते ।
सोमसूर्याग्निसंपन्ने मूर्तित्रयसमन्विते ॥
2.26.m: accompanied by peace, seed, sprout, the infinite, virtue, and the rest, / endowed with the moon, sun, and fire, accompanied by the triad of forms,

2.26.s:
vāmādibhiśca sahite manonmanyāpyadhiṣṭhite /
śivāsanetmamūrtisthamakṣayākāra rūpiṇam //
2.26.d:
वामादिभिश्च सहिते मनोन्मन्याप्यधिष्ठिते ।
शिवासनेत्ममूर्तिस्थमक्षयाकार रूपिणम् ॥
2.26.m: together with Vāmā and the other [śaktis], presided over also by Manonmanī, / abiding in the form on the seat of Śiva, having the nature of an imperishable form,

2.26.s:
aṣṭatriṃśatkalādehṝṃ tritattvasahitaṃ śivam /
aṣṭādaśabhujaṃ devaṃ gajacarmottarīyakam //
2.26.d:
अष्टत्रिंशत्कलादेहॄं त्रितत्त्वसहितं शिवम् ।
अष्टादशभुजं देवं गजचर्मोत्तरीयकम् ॥
2.26.m: Śiva possessing a body of thirty-eight kalās, accompanied by the three tattvas, / the eighteen-armed god having an upper garment of elephant hide,

2.26.s:
siṃhājināṃbaradharamaghoraṃ parameśvaram /
dvātriṃśākṣararūpeṇa dvātriṃśacchaktibhirvṛtam //
2.26.d:
सिंहाजिनांबरधरमघोरं परमेश्वरम् ।
द्वात्रिंशाक्षररूपेण द्वात्रिंशच्छक्तिभिर्वृतम् ॥
2.26.m: wearing a garment of lion-skin, Aghora, the supreme lord, / in the form of thirty-two syllables, surrounded by thirty-two śaktis,

2.26.s:
sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktaṃ sarvadevanamaskṛtam /
kapālamālābharaṇaṃ sarvavṛścikabhūthamaṇ //
2.26.d:
सर्वाभरणसंयुक्तं सर्वदेवनमस्कृतम् ।
कपालमालाभरणं सर्ववृश्चिकभूथमण् ॥
2.26.m: endowed with all ornaments, worshipped by all gods, / adorned with a garland of skulls, ornamented with all kinds of scorpions,

2.26.s:
pūrṇoduvadanaṃ saumyaṃ candrakoṭisamaprabham /
candrarekhādharaṃ śaktyā sahitaṃ nīlarūpiṇam //
2.26.d:
पूर्णोदुवदनं सौम्यं चन्द्रकोटिसमप्रभम् ।
चन्द्ररेखाधरं शक्त्या सहितं नीलरूपिणम् ॥
2.26.m: with a face like the full moon, gentle, having a splendour equal to ten million moons, / bearing the crescent moon, accompanied by Śakti, possessing a dark-blue form;

2.26.s:
haste khaḍgaṃ kheṭakaṃ pāśamekeratnaiścitraṃ cāṅkuśaṃ nāgakakṣām /
śarasanaṃ pāśupataṃ tathāstraṃ daṇḍaṃ ca khaṭvāṅgamathāpare ca //
2.26.d:
हस्ते खड्गं खेटकं पाशमेकेरत्नैश्चित्रं चाङ्कुशं नागकक्षाम् ।
शरसनं पाशुपतं तथास्त्रं दण्डं च खट्वाङ्गमथापरे च ॥
2.26.m: in one hand a sword, a shield, a noose, a goad variegated with jewels, a snake-girdle, / a bow, the Pāśupata weapon, a staff, and next a skull-topped staff (khaṭvāṅga);

2.26.s:
tantrīṃ ca ghaṇṭāṃ vipulaṃ ca śūlaṃ tathāpare ḍāmarukaṃ ca divyam /
vajraṃ gadāṃ ṭaṅkamekaṃ ca dīptaṃ samudraraṃ hastamathāsya śaṃbhoḥ //
2.26.d:
तन्त्रीं च घण्टां विपुलं च शूलं तथापरे डामरुकं च दिव्यम् ।
वज्रं गदां टङ्कमेकं च दीप्तं समुद्ररं हस्तमथास्य शंभोः ॥
2.26.m: a lute, a bell, a great trident, and in another a celestial damaru, / a thunderbolt, a mace, a chisel, and one luminous hand of Śambhu holding a hammer;

2.26.s:
varadābhayahastaṃ ca vareṇyaṃ parameśvaram /
bhāvayetpūjayeccāpi vahnau homaṃ ca kārayet //
2.26.d:
वरदाभयहस्तं च वरेण्यं परमेश्वरम् ।
भावयेत्पूजयेच्चापि वह्नौ होमं च कारयेत् ॥
2.26.m: and hands granting boons and fearlessness—one should meditate on the supreme lord, the most choice, / worship him, and perform oblation into the fire.

2.26.s:
homaśca pūrvavatsarvo mantrabhedaśca kīrtitaḥ /
aṣṭapuṣpādi gandhādi pūjāstutinivedanam //
2.26.d:
होमश्च पूर्ववत्सर्वो मन्त्रभेदश्च कीर्तितः ।
अष्टपुष्पादि गन्धादि पूजास्तुतिनिवेदनम् ॥
2.26.m: And the entire oblation is as before, with the difference of mantras declared: / the eight flowers and so forth, scents and so forth, worship, praise, and presentation of offerings;

2.26.s:
antarbaliṃ ca kuṇḍasya vāhneyena vidhānataḥ /
maṇḍalaṃ vidhinā kṛtvā mantrairetairyathākramam //
2.26.d:
अन्तर्बलिं च कुण्डस्य वाह्नेयेन विधानतः ।
मण्डलं विधिना कृत्वा मन्त्रैरेतैर्यथाक्रमम् ॥
2.26.m: and the internal bali of the fire-pit in accordance with rule through the fire-mantra. / Having drawn the maṇḍala according to rule, with these mantras in proper order:

2.26.s:
rudrebhyo mātṛgaṇebhyo yakṣebhyo 'surebhyo grahebhyo rākṣasebhyo nāgebhyo nakṣatrebhyo viśvagaṇebhyaḥ kṣetrapālebhyaḥ atha vāyuvaruṇadigbhāge kṣetrapālabaliṃ kṣipet /
arghyaṃ gandhaṃ ca puṣpaṃ ca dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca suvratāḥ /
naivedyaṃ mukhavāsādi nivedyaṃ vai yathāvidhi //
2.26.d:
रुद्रेभ्यो मातृगणेभ्यो यक्षेभ्यो ऽसुरेभ्यो ग्रहेभ्यो राक्षसेभ्यो नागेभ्यो नक्षत्रेभ्यो विश्वगणेभ्यः क्षेत्रपालेभ्यः अथ वायुवरुणदिग्भागे क्षेत्रपालबलिं क्षिपेत् ।
अर्घ्यं गन्धं च पुष्पं च धूपं दीपं च सुव्रताः ।
नैवेद्यं मुखवासादि निवेद्यं वै यथाविधि ॥
2.26.m: "To the Rudras, to the host of Mothers, to the yakṣas, to the asuras, to the planets, to the rākṣasas, to the nāgas, to the lunar mansions, to the all-gods, to the guardians of the field (kṣetrapālas)"—then he should cast the offering for the guardian of the field in the north-western direction (vāyu-varuṇa). / Water of welcome, scent, flowers, incense, a lamp, O you of noble vows, / food-offering, mouth-perfume, and the rest must indeed be offered according to rule.

2.26.s:
vijñāpyaivaṃ visṛjyātha aṣṭapuṣpaiśca pūjanam /
sarvasāmānyametaddhi pūjāyāṃ munipuṅgavāḥ //
2.26.d:
विज्ञाप्यैवं विसृज्याथ अष्टपुष्पैश्च पूजनम् ।
सर्वसामान्यमेतद्धि पूजायां मुनिपुङ्गवाः ॥
2.26.m: Having thus made request and then dismissed [the deity], worship with eight flowers [is done]. / This is common to all worship, O best of sages.

2.26.s:
evaṃ saṃkṣepataḥ proktamaghorārcādi suvrata /
aghorārcāvidhānaṃ ca liṅgevā sthāṇḍile 'pi vā //
2.26.d:
एवं संक्षेपतः प्रोक्तमघोरार्चादि सुव्रत ।
अघोरार्चाविधानं च लिङ्गेवा स्थाण्डिले ऽपि वा ॥
2.26.m: Thus the worship of Aghora and the rest has been described in brief, O one of noble vows. / And the procedure for worshipping Aghora [may be performed] in a liṅga or on an altar.

2.26.s:
sthaṇḍilātkoṭiguṇitaṃ liṅgārcanamanuttamam /
liṅgārcanarato vipro mahāpātakasaṃbhavaiḥ //
2.26.d:
स्थण्डिलात्कोटिगुणितं लिङ्गार्चनमनुत्तमम् ।
लिङ्गार्चनरतो विप्रो महापातकसंभवैः ॥
2.26.m: Worship of the liṅga is ten million times greater than on an altar; it is unsurpassable. / A brāhmaṇa devoted to the worship of the liṅga is not tainted / even by sins born of the greatest crimes, just as a lotus leaf is not by water.

2.26.s:
pāpairapi na lipyeta padmapatramivāṃbhasā /
liṅgasya darśanaṃ puṇyaṃ darśanātsparśanaṃ varam //
2.26.d:
पापैरपि न लिप्येत पद्मपत्रमिवांभसा ।
लिङ्गस्य दर्शनं पुण्यं दर्शनात्स्पर्शनं वरम् ॥
2.26.m: The sight of the liṅga brings merit; better than sight is touching it; / than worship there is nothing higher, O son of Brahmā, there is no doubt.

2.26.s:
arcanādadhikaṃ nāsti brahmaputra na saṃśayaḥ /
evaṃ saṃkṣepataḥ proktamaghorārcanamuttamam //
2.26.d:
अर्चनादधिकं नास्ति ब्रह्मपुत्र न संशयः ।
एवं संक्षेपतः प्रोक्तमघोरार्चनमुत्तमम् ॥
2.26.m: Thus the supreme worship of Aghora has been related in brief. / Even in a hundred million years it cannot be told in detail.

2.26.s:
varṣakoṭiśatenāpi vistareṇa na śakyate //
iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge ṣaḍviṃśatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
2.26.d:
वर्षकोटिशतेनापि विस्तरेण न शक्यते ॥
इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे उत्तरभागे षड्विंशतितमो ऽध्यायः
2.26.m:
[it] cannot [be described] in detail even in a hundred crore years.

Thus ends the twenty-sixth chapter in the latter part of the glorious Liṅga Mahāpurāṇa.

2.27.s:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
prabhāvo nandinaścaiva liṅgapujāphalaṃ śrutam /
śrutibhiḥ saṃmitaṃ sarvaṃ romaharṣaṇa suvrata //
2.27.d:
ऋषय ऊचुः
प्रभावो नन्दिनश्चैव लिङ्गपुजाफलं श्रुतम् ।
श्रुतिभिः संमितं सर्वं रोमहर्षण सुव्रत ॥
2.27.m: The sages said: / The power of Nandin and the fruit of worshipping the liṅga have been heard, / all being in accordance with the Vedas, O Romaharṣaṇa of noble vows.

2.27.s:
jayābhiṣeka īśena kathito manave purā /
hitāya meruśikhare kṣatriyāṇāṃ triśulinā //
2.27.d:
जयाभिषेक ईशेन कथितो मनवे पुरा ।
हिताय मेरुशिखरे क्षत्रियाणां त्रिशुलिना ॥
2.27.m: The royal consecration for victory (jayābhiṣeka) was spoken of old by the Lord, the wielder of the trident, / to Manu on the peak of Meru for the benefit of kṣatriyas.

2.27.s:
tatkathaṃ ṣoḍaśavidhaṃ mahādānaṃ ca śobhanam /
vaktumarhasi cāsmākaṃ sūta buddhimatāṃvara //
2.27.d:
तत्कथं षोडशविधं महादानं च शोभनम् ।
वक्तुमर्हसि चास्माकं सूत बुद्धिमतांवर ॥
2.27.m: How is that, and the auspicious sixteenfold Great Gift (mahādāna)? / You should declare it to us, O Sūta, best among the wise.

2.27.s:
sūta uvāca
jīvacchrāddhaṃ purā kṛtvā manuḥ svāyaṃbhuvaḥ prabhuḥ /
merumāsādya deveśamastavīnnīlalohitam //
2.27.d:
सूत उवाच
जीवच्छ्राद्धं पुरा कृत्वा मनुः स्वायंभुवः प्रभुः ।
मेरुमासाद्य देवेशमस्तवीन्नीललोहितम् ॥
2.27.m: Sūta said: / Formerly, having performed the living-śrāddha (jīvacchrāddha), the powerful Svāyambhuva Manu, / having reached Meru, praised the lord of gods, Nīlalohita.

2.27.s:
tapasā ca vinītāya prahṛṣṭaḥ pradadau bhavaḥ /
divyaṃ darśanamīśānas tenāpaśyat tam avyayam //
2.27.d:
तपसा च विनीताय प्रहृष्टः प्रददौ भवः ।
दिव्यं दर्शनमीशानस् तेनापश्यत् तम् अव्ययम् ॥
2.27.m: Bhava, highly pleased, granted a divine vision to him who was humble through asceticism; / by that he saw the imperishable Īśāna.

2.27.s:
natvā saṃpūjya vidhinā kṛtāñjalipuṭaḥ sthitaḥ /
pūjitaśca tato devo dṛṣṭaścaiva mayādhunā /
śakraāya kathitaṃ pūrvaṃ dharmakāmārthamokṣadam //
2.27.d:
नत्वा संपूज्य विधिना कृताञ्जलिपुटः स्थितः ।
पूजितश्च ततो देवो दृष्टश्चैव मयाधुना ।
शक्रआय कथितं पूर्वं धर्मकामार्थमोक्षदम् ॥
2.27.m: Having bowed and worshipped according to rule, he stood with hands folded in reverence. / "The god has been worshipped and seen by me now; / that which was formerly spoken to Śakra, which yields dharma, desire, wealth, and liberation—

2.27.s:
devadeva jagannātha namaste bhuvaneśvara /
jīvacchrāddhaṃ mahādeva prasādena vinirmitam //
2.27.d:
देवदेव जगन्नाथ नमस्ते भुवनेश्वर ।
जीवच्छ्राद्धं महादेव प्रसादेन विनिर्मितम् ॥
2.27.m: O god of gods, O lord of the world, obeisance to you, O lord of the universe! / The living-śrāddha, O Mahādeva, was accomplished through your grace.

2.27.s:
pūjitaś ca tato devo dṛṣṭaś caiva mayādhunā /
śakraāya kathitaṃ pūrvaṃ dharmakāmārthamokṣadam //
2.27.d:
पूजितश् च ततो देवो दृष्टश् चैव मयाधुना ।
शक्रआय कथितं पूर्वं धर्मकामार्थमोक्षदम् ॥
2.27.m: The god has been worshipped and seen by me now; / that which was formerly spoken to Śakra, which yields dharma, desire, wealth, and liberation—

2.27.s:
jayābhiṣekaṃ deveśa vaktumarhasi me prabho /
sūta uvāca
tasmai devo mahādevo bhagavānnīlalohitaḥ //
2.27.d:
जयाभिषेकं देवेश वक्तुमर्हसि मे प्रभो ।
सूत उवाच
तस्मै देवो महादेवो भगवान्नीललोहितः ॥
2.27.m: you should tell me, O Lord, about the royal consecration for victory, O lord of gods!" / Sūta said: / To him the god, Mahādeva, the blessed Nīlalohita,

2.27.s:
jayābhiṣekamakhilamavadatparameśvaraḥ /
śrībhagavānuvāca
jayābhaṣekaṃ vakṣyāmi nṛpāṇāṃ hitakāmyayā //
2.27.d:
जयाभिषेकमखिलमवदत्परमेश्वरः ।
श्रीभगवानुवाच
जयाभषेकं वक्ष्यामि नृपाणां हितकाम्यया ॥
2.27.m: the supreme lord, spoke the entire consecration for victory. / The Blessed Lord said: / I shall declare the consecration for victory out of a desire for the welfare of kings,

2.27.s:
apamṛtyujayārthaṃ ca sarvaśatrujayāya ca /
yuddhakāle tu saṃprāpte kṛtvaivamabhiṣecanam //
2.27.d:
अपमृत्युजयार्थं च सर्वशत्रुजयाय च ।
युद्धकाले तु संप्राप्ते कृत्वैवमभिषेचनम् ॥
2.27.m: for the sake of overcoming untimely death and conquering all enemies. / When the time of battle arrives, having performed this consecration,

2.27.s:
svapatiṃ cābhiṣicyaiva gacchedyoddhuṃ raṇājire /
vidhinā maṇḍapaṃ kṛtvā prapāṃvā kūṭameva vā //
2.27.d:
स्वपतिं चाभिषिच्यैव गच्छेद्योद्धुं रणाजिरे ।
विधिना मण्डपं कृत्वा प्रपांवा कूटमेव वा ॥
2.27.m: and having consecrated the king himself, he should go out to fight on the field of battle. / Having constructed a pavilion (maṇḍapa) according to rule, or a shed, or a cottage,

2.27.s:
navadhā stāpayedvahniṃ brāhmaṇo vedapāragaḥ /
tataḥ sarvābhiṣekārthaṃ sūtrapātaṃ ca kārayet //
2.27.d:
नवधा स्तापयेद्वह्निं ब्राह्मणो वेदपारगः ।
ततः सर्वाभिषेकार्थं सूत्रपातं च कारयेत् ॥
2.27.m: a brāhmaṇa who has mastered the Vedas should establish the fire in ninefold fashion. / Then, for the sake of the complete consecration, he should cast the measuring lines:

2.27.s:
prāgādyaṃ varṇasūtrañca dakṣiṇādyaṃ tathā punaḥ /
sahasrāṇāṃ dvayaṃ tatra śatānāṃ ca catuṣṭayam //
2.27.d:
प्रागाद्यं वर्णसूत्रञ्च दक्षिणाद्यं तथा पुनः ।
सहस्राणां द्वयं तत्र शतानां च चतुष्टयम् ॥
2.27.m: the coloured lines beginning from the east, and likewise those beginning from the south; / there [shall be] two thousand and four hundred [divisions],

2.27.s:
śeṣameva subhaṃ koṣṭhaṃ teṣu koṣṭhaṃ tu saṃharet /
bāhye vīthyāṃ padañcaikaṃ samantādupasaṃharet //
2.27.d:
शेषमेव सुभं कोष्ठं तेषु कोष्ठं तु संहरेत् ।
बाह्ये वीथ्यां पदञ्चैकं समन्तादुपसंहरेत् ॥
2.27.m: the remaining auspicious square (koṣṭha); among them he should retract the square: / on the outer lane he should retract one space (pada) on all sides.

2.27.s:
aṅgasūtrāṇi saṃgṛhya vidhinā pṛthageva tu /
prāgādyaṃ varṇasūtraṃ ca dakṣiṇādyaṃ tathā punaḥ //
2.27.d:
अङ्गसूत्राणि संगृह्य विधिना पृथगेव तु ।
प्रागाद्यं वर्णसूत्रं च दक्षिणाद्यं तथा पुनः ॥
2.27.m: Taking the subsidiary lines according to rule separately, / the coloured lines beginning from the east and likewise those beginning from the south,

2.27.s:
prāgādyandakṣiṇādyaṃ ca ṣaṭtriśatsaṃharetkramāt /
prāgādyāḥ paṅktayaḥ sapta dakṣiṇādyāstathā punaḥ //
2.27.d:
प्रागाद्यन्दक्षिणाद्यं च षट्त्रिशत्संहरेत्क्रमात् ।
प्रागाद्याः पङ्क्तयः सप्त दक्षिणाद्यास्तथा पुनः ॥
2.27.m: he should sequentially retract thirty-six [squares] from the east and from the south: / seven rows beginning from the east, and likewise those beginning from the south.

2.27.s:
tasmādekonapañcāśatpaṅktayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ /
nava paṅktīrharenmadhye gandhagomayavāriṇā //
2.27.d:
तस्मादेकोनपञ्चाशत्पङ्क्तयः परिकीर्तिताः ।
नव पङ्क्तीर्हरेन्मध्ये गन्धगोमयवारिणा ॥
2.27.m: Therefore, forty-nine lines are prescribed. / One should remove nine lines in the centre with scented cow-dung water,

2.27.s:
kamalaṃ cālikhettatra hastāmātreṇa śobhanam /
aṣṭapatraṃ sitaṃ vṛttaṃ karṇikākesarānvitam //
2.27.d:
कमलं चालिखेत्तत्र हस्तामात्रेण शोभनम् ।
अष्टपत्रं सितं वृत्तं कर्णिकाकेसरान्वितम् ॥
2.27.m: and draw there a splendid lotus measuring one cubit, / eight-petalled, white, circular, and provided with a pericarp and filaments.

2.27.s:
aṣṭāṅgulapramāṇena karṇikā hemasannibhā /
caturaṅgulamānena kesarasthānamucyate //
2.27.d:
अष्टाङ्गुलप्रमाणेन कर्णिका हेमसन्निभा ।
चतुरङ्गुलमानेन केसरस्थानमुच्यते ॥
2.27.m: The pericarp, resembling gold, measures eight angulas; / the place of the filaments is said to measure four angulas.

2.27.s:
dharmo jñānaṃ ca vairāgyamaiśvaryaṃ ca yathākramam /
āgneyādiṣu koṇeṣu sthāpayetpraṇavena tu //
2.27.d:
धर्मो ज्ञानं च वैराग्यमैश्वर्यं च यथाक्रमम् ।
आग्नेयादिषु कोणेषु स्थापयेत्प्रणवेन तु ॥
2.27.m: In the corners beginning with the south-east, one should install in due order / Dharma, Jñāna, Vairāgya, and Aiśvarya by means of the Praṇava.

2.27.s:
avyaktādīni vai dikṣu gātrākāreṇa vai nyaset /
avyaktaṃ niyataḥ kālaḥ kālī ceti catuṣṭayam //
2.27.d:
अव्यक्तादीनि वै दिक्षु गात्राकारेण वै न्यसेत् ।
अव्यक्तं नियतः कालः काली चेति चतुष्टयम् ॥
2.27.m: In the cardinal directions, one should place the unmanifest and the others as the limbs: / the unmanifest, the ordained, time, and Kālī—these four.

2.27.s:
sitaraktahiraṇyābhakṛṣṇā dharmādayaḥ kramāt /
haṃsākāreṇa vai gātraṃ hemābhāsena suvratāḥ //
2.27.d:
सितरक्तहिरण्याभकृष्णा धर्मादयः क्रमात् ।
हंसाकारेण वै गात्रं हेमाभासेन सुव्रताः ॥
2.27.m: Dharma and the others are respectively white, red, golden, and black. / O observers of good vows, the limbs [have] the form of swans shining like gold.

2.27.s:
ādhāraśaktimadhye tu kamalaṃ sṛṣṭikāraṇam /
bindumātraṃ kalāmadhye nādākāramataḥ param //
2.27.d:
आधारशक्तिमध्ये तु कमलं सृष्टिकारणम् ।
बिन्दुमात्रं कलामध्ये नादाकारमतः परम् ॥
2.27.m: In the middle of the supporting power (ādhāraśakti) is the lotus, the cause of creation; / in the middle of the kalā is the mere bindu, and beyond that what has the form of nāda.

2.27.s:
nādopari śivaṃ dhyāyedāeṅkārakhyaṃ jagadgurum /
manonmanīṃ ca padmābhaṃmahādevaṃ ca bhāvayet //
2.27.d:
नादोपरि शिवं ध्यायेदाएङ्कारख्यं जगद्गुरुम् ।
मनोन्मनीं च पद्माभंमहादेवं च भावयेत् ॥
2.27.m: Above the nāda, one should meditate on Śiva, named the syllable Om, the guru of the universe; / and one should contemplate Manonmanī and Mahādeva, who shines like a lotus.

2.27.s:
vāmādayaḥ krameṇaiva prāgādyāḥ kesareṣu vai /
vāmā jyeṣṭhā tathā raudrī kālī vikaraṇī tathā //
2.27.d:
वामादयः क्रमेणैव प्रागाद्याः केसरेषु वै ।
वामा ज्येष्ठा तथा रौद्री काली विकरणी तथा ॥
2.27.m: Vāmā and the others are in due order on the filaments, beginning from the east: / Vāmā, Jyeṣṭhā, Raudrī, Kālī, Vikaraṇī,

2.27.s:
balā pramathinī devī damanī ca yathāṅkramam /
vāmadevādibhiḥ sārdhaṃ praṇavenaiva vinyaset //
2.27.d:
बला प्रमथिनी देवी दमनी च यथाङ्क्रमम् ।
वामदेवादिभिः सार्धं प्रणवेनैव विन्यसेत् ॥
2.27.m: Balā, Pramathinī, the goddess Damanī, in due order. / One should deposit them along with Vāmadeva and the others, by means of the Praṇava itself:

2.27.s: namo 'stu vāmadevāya namo jyeṣṭhāya śūline //
2.27.d: नमो ऽस्तु वामदेवाय नमो ज्येष्ठाय शूलिने ॥
2.27.m: “Homage to Vāmadeva, homage to Jyeṣṭha, to the Trident-bearer,

2.27.s:
rudrāya kālarūpāya kalāvikaraṇāya ca /
balāya ca tathā sarvabhūtasya damanāya ca //
2.27.d:
रुद्राय कालरूपाय कलाविकरणाय च ।
बलाय च तथा सर्वभूतस्य दमनाय च ॥
2.27.m: to Rudra, to the form of Time, and to Kalāvikaraṇa, / and to Bala, and to the Subduer of all beings,

2.27.s:
manonmanāya devāya manonmanyai namonamaḥ /
mantrairetairyathānyāyaṃ pūjayetparimaṇḍalam //
2.27.d:
मनोन्मनाय देवाय मनोन्मन्यै नमोनमः ।
मन्त्रैरेतैर्यथान्यायं पूजयेत्परिमण्डलम् ॥
2.27.m: to the god Manonmana, to Manonmanī, homage, homage!” / With these mantras one should worship the surrounding circle according to the rules.

2.27.s:
prathamāvaraṇaṃ proktaṃ dvitīyāvaraṇaṃ śruṇu /
dvitīyāvaraṇe caiva śaktayaḥ ṣoḍaśaiva tu //
2.27.d:
प्रथमावरणं प्रोक्तं द्वितीयावरणं श्रुणु ।
द्वितीयावरणे चैव शक्तयः षोडशैव तु ॥
2.27.m: The first enclosure has been spoken of; hear of the second enclosure. / In the second enclosure there are precisely sixteen powers.

2.27.s:
tṛtīyāvaraṇe caiva caturviśadanukramāt /
piśāca vīrthirvai madhye nābhivīthiḥ samantataḥ //
2.27.d:
तृतीयावरणे चैव चतुर्विशदनुक्रमात् ।
पिशाच वीर्थिर्वै मध्ये नाभिवीथिः समन्ततः ॥
2.27.m: And in the third enclosure, in succession, twenty-four. / The piśāca-lane is in the middle, and the navel-lane on all sides.

2.27.s:
mantrairetairyathānyāyaṃ piśācānāṃ prakīrtitā /
aṣṭottarasahasraṃ tu padamaṣṭārasaṃyutam //
2.27.d:
मन्त्रैरेतैर्यथान्यायं पिशाचानां प्रकीर्तिता ।
अष्टोत्तरसहस्रं तु पदमष्टारसंयुतम् ॥
2.27.m: With these mantras [the worship] of the piśācas is prescribed according to rule. / There is an eight-spoked [diagram] with one thousand and eight squares.

2.27.s:
teṣuteṣu pṛthaktvena padeṣu kamalaṃ kramāt /
kalpayecchālinīvāragodhūmaiśca yavādibhiḥ //
2.27.d:
तेषुतेषु पृथक्त्वेन पदेषु कमलं क्रमात् ।
कल्पयेच्छालिनीवारगोधूमैश्च यवादिभिः ॥
2.27.m: In each of those respective squares one should construct in order a lotus / with winter rice, nivāra rice, wheat, and barley and the like,

2.27.s:
taṇḍulaiśca tilairvātha gaurasarṣapasaṃyutaiḥ /
athavā kalpayedetairyathākālaṃ vidhānataḥ //
2.27.d:
तण्डुलैश्च तिलैर्वाथ गौरसर्षपसंयुतैः ।
अथवा कल्पयेदेतैर्यथाकालं विधानतः ॥
2.27.m: with husked rice or sesame seeds together with white mustard, / or one should construct these according to the proper time and rule.

2.27.s:
aṣṭapatraṃ likhetteṣu karṇikākesarānvitam /
śālīnāmāḍhakaṃ proktaṃ kamalānāṃ pṛthak pṛthak //
2.27.d:
अष्टपत्रं लिखेत्तेषु कर्णिकाकेसरान्वितम् ।
शालीनामाढकं प्रोक्तं कमलानां पृथक् पृथक् ॥
2.27.m: One should draw on them an eight-petalled [lotus] endowed with a pericarp and filaments. / An āḍhaka of winter rice is prescribed for each lotus separately.

2.27.s:
taṇḍulānāṃ tadardhaṃ syāttadardhaṃ ca yavādayaḥ /
droṇaṃ pradhānakuṃbhasya tadardhaṃ taṇḍulāḥ smṛtāḥ //
2.27.d:
तण्डुलानां तदर्धं स्यात्तदर्धं च यवादयः ।
द्रोणं प्रधानकुंभस्य तदर्धं तण्डुलाः स्मृताः ॥
2.27.m: Half of that should be husked rice, and half of that barley and the like. / A droṇa [is prescribed] for the principal jar, and half of that is recorded to be husked rice.

2.27.s:
tilānāmāḍhakaṃ madhye yavānāṃ ca tadardhakam /
athāṃbhasā samabhyukṣya kamalaṃ praṇavena tu //
2.27.d:
तिलानामाढकं मध्ये यवानां च तदर्धकम् ।
अथांभसा समभ्युक्ष्य कमलं प्रणवेन तु ॥
2.27.m: An āḍhaka of sesame in the middle, and half of that of barley. / Then, having sprinkled the lotus with water by means of the Praṇava,

2.27.s:
teṣu sarveṣu vidhinā praṇavaṃ vinyasetkramāt /
evaṃ samāpya cābhyukṣya padasāhasramuttamam //
2.27.d:
तेषु सर्वेषु विधिना प्रणवं विन्यसेत्क्रमात् ।
एवं समाप्य चाभ्युक्ष्य पदसाहस्रमुत्तमम् ॥
2.27.m: one should duly deposit the Praṇava upon all of them in order. / Having thus completed and sprinkled the excellent one thousand squares,

2.27.s:
kalaśānāṃ sahasrāṇi haimāni ca śubhāni ca /
uktalakṣaṇayuktānu kārayedrājatāni vā //
2.27.d:
कलशानां सहस्राणि हैमानि च शुभानि च ।
उक्तलक्षणयुक्तानु कारयेद्राजतानि वा ॥
2.27.m: one should have thousands of jars made, auspicious and of gold, / endowed with the prescribed characteristics, or of silver,

2.27.s:
tāmrajāni yatānyāyaṃ praṇavenārghyavāriṇā /
dvādaśāṅgulavistāramudare samudāhṛtam //
2.27.d:
ताम्रजानि यतान्यायं प्रणवेनार्घ्यवारिणा ।
द्वादशाङ्गुलविस्तारमुदरे समुदाहृतम् ॥
2.27.m: or made of copper according to rule, with the Praṇava and arghya water. / A width of twelve angulas at the belly is stated;

2.27.s:
vartitaṃ tu tadardhena nābhistasya vidhīyate /
kaṇṭhaṃ tu dvyaṅgulotsedhaṃ vistaraṃ caturaṅgulam //
2.27.d:
वर्तितं तु तदर्धेन नाभिस्तस्य विधीयते ।
कण्ठं तु द्व्यङ्गुलोत्सेधं विस्तरं चतुरङ्गुलम् ॥
2.27.m: its navel is prescribed to be rounded to half of that. / The neck is two angulas in height and four angulas in width.

2.27.s:
oṣṭhaṃ ca dvyaṅgulotsedhaṃ nirgamaṃ dvyagulaṃsmṛtam /
tattadvai dviguṇaṃ divyaṃ śivakuṃbhe prakīrtitam //
2.27.d:
ओष्ठं च द्व्यङ्गुलोत्सेधं निर्गमं द्व्यगुलंस्मृतम् ।
तत्तद्वै द्विगुणं दिव्यं शिवकुंभे प्रकीर्तितम् ॥
2.27.m: The lip is two angulas in height, and the rim is recorded as two angulas. / That same [measurement] doubled is declared for the divine jar of Śiva.

2.27.s:
yavāmātrāntaraṃ samyaktantunā veṣṭayeddhi vai /
avaguṇṭhya tathābhyukṣya kuśopariyatāvidhi //
2.27.d:
यवामात्रान्तरं सम्यक्तन्तुना वेष्टयेद्धि वै ।
अवगुण्ठ्य तथाभ्युक्ष्य कुशोपरियताविधि ॥
2.27.m: One should wind it thoroughly with thread at intervals of a barleycorn. / Having veiled it and sprinkled it upon kuśa grass according to rule,

2.27.s:
pūrvavatpraṇavenaiva pūrayedgandhavāriṇā /
sthāpayecchivakuṃbhāḍhyaṃ vardhanīṃ ca vidānataḥ //
2.27.d:
पूर्ववत्प्रणवेनैव पूरयेद्गन्धवारिणा ।
स्थापयेच्छिवकुंभाढ्यं वर्धनीं च विदानतः ॥
2.27.m: one should fill it with scented water with the Praṇava as before. / One should install the Vardhanī along with the jar of Śiva according to rule.

2.27.s:
madhyapadmāsya madhye tu sakūrcaṃ sākṣataṃ kramāt /
āveṣṭya vastrayugmena pracchādya kamalena tu //
2.27.d:
मध्यपद्मास्य मध्ये तु सकूर्चं साक्षतं क्रमात् ।
आवेष्ट्य वस्त्रयुग्मेन प्रच्छाद्य कमलेन तु ॥
2.27.m: In the middle of the mouth of the central lotus, with kūrca grass and unblemished grains in succession, / having wrapped it with a pair of cloths and covered it with a lotus

2.27.s:
haimena citraratnena sahasrakalaśaṃ pṛthak /
śivakuṃbhe śivaṃ sthāpya gāyatryā praṇaveja ca //
2.27.d:
हैमेन चित्ररत्नेन सहस्रकलशं पृथक् ।
शिवकुंभे शिवं स्थाप्य गायत्र्या प्रणवेज च ॥
2.27.m: made of gold and multi-coloured gems, for each of the thousand jars, / having installed Śiva in the jar of Śiva with the Gāyatrī and the Praṇava:

2.27.s:
vidmahaṃ puruṣāyaiva mahādevāya dhīmahi /
tanno rudraḥ pracodayāt //
2.27.d:
विद्महं पुरुषायैव महादेवाय धीमहि ।
तन्नो रुद्रः प्रचोदयात् ॥
2.27.m: “May we know the Puruṣa; let us meditate on Mahādeva. / May Rudra inspire us thereto.”

2.27.s:
mantreṇānena rudrasya sānnidhyaṃ sarvadā smṛtam /
vardhanyāṃ devigāyatryā devīṃ saṃsthāpya pūjayet //
2.27.d:
मन्त्रेणानेन रुद्रस्य सान्निध्यं सर्वदा स्मृतम् ।
वर्धन्यां देविगायत्र्या देवीं संस्थाप्य पूजयेत् ॥
2.27.m: By this mantra the presence of Rudra is always traditionally held [to occur]. / Installing the goddess in the Vardhanī with the Devī-gāyatrī, one should worship her:

2.27.s:
gaṇāṃbikāyai vidmahe mahātapāyai dhīmahi /
tanno gaurī pracodayāt //
2.27.d:
गणांबिकायै विद्महे महातपायै धीमहि ।
तन्नो गौरी प्रचोदयात् ॥
2.27.m: “May we know Gaṇāmbikā; let us meditate on the One of Great Tapas. / May Gaurī inspire us thereto.”

2.27.s:
prathamāvaraṇe caiva vāmādyāḥ parikīrtitāḥ /
prathamāvaraṇaṃ proktaṃ dvitīyāvaraṇaṃ śruṇu //
2.27.d:
प्रथमावरणे चैव वामाद्याः परिकीर्तिताः ।
प्रथमावरणं प्रोक्तं द्वितीयावरणं श्रुणु ॥
2.27.m: Vāmā and the others are prescribed in the first enclosure. / The first enclosure has been spoken of; hear of the second enclosure.

2.27.s:
śaktayaḥ ṣoḍaśaivātra pūrvādyānteṣu suvrata /
eendravyūhasya madhye tu subhadrāṃ sthāpya pūjayet //
2.27.d:
शक्तयः षोडशैवात्र पूर्वाद्यान्तेषु सुव्रत ।
एएन्द्रव्यूहस्य मध्ये तु सुभद्रां स्थाप्य पूजयेत् ॥
2.27.m: Here there are sixteen powers, O you of good vows, at the ends [of directions] beginning with the east. / In the middle of the troop of Indra, having installed Subhadrā, one should worship her.

2.27.s:
bhadrāmāgneyacakre tu yāmye tu kanakāṇḍajām /
aṃbikāṃ nairṛte vyūhe madhyakuṃbhe tu pūjayet //
2.27.d:
भद्रामाग्नेयचक्रे तु याम्ये तु कनकाण्डजाम् ।
अंबिकां नैरृते व्यूहे मध्यकुंभे तु पूजयेत् ॥
2.27.m: One should worship Bhadrā in the south-eastern circle, Kanakāṇḍajā in the southern, / and Ambikā in the south-western troop in the central jar.

2.27.s:
śrīdevīṃ vāruṇe bhāge vāgīśāṃ vāyugocare /
gomukhīṃ saumyabhāge tu madhyakuṃbhe tu pūjayet //
2.27.d:
श्रीदेवीं वारुणे भागे वागीशां वायुगोचरे ।
गोमुखीं सौम्यभागे तु मध्यकुंभे तु पूजयेत् ॥
2.27.m: One should worship Śrīdevī in the western quarter, Vāgīśā in the realm of Vāyu, / and Gomukhī in the northern quarter in the central jar.

2.27.s:
rudravyūhasya madhye tu bhadrakarṇāṃ samarcayet /
eendrāgnividisormadhye pūjayedaṇimāṃ śubhām //
2.27.d:
रुद्रव्यूहस्य मध्ये तु भद्रकर्णां समर्चयेत् ।
एएन्द्राग्निविदिसोर्मध्ये पूजयेदणिमां शुभाम् ॥
2.27.m: In the middle of the troop of Rudra one should worship Bhadrakarṇā. / Between the directions of Indra and Agni, one should worship auspicious Aṇiman.

2.27.s:
yāmyapāvakayormadhye laghimāṃ kamale nyaset /
rākṣasāṃtakayormadhye mahimāṃ madhyato yajet //
2.27.d:
याम्यपावकयोर्मध्ये लघिमां कमले न्यसेत् ।
राक्षसांतकयोर्मध्ये महिमां मध्यतो यजेत् ॥
2.27.m: Between Yama and Fire, one should place Laghiman on the lotus. / Between the Rakṣas and Death, one should worship Mahiman in the centre.

2.27.s:
varuṇāsurayormadhye prāptiṃ vai madhyato yajet /
varuṇānilayormadhye prākāmyaṃ kamale nyaset //
2.27.d:
वरुणासुरयोर्मध्ये प्राप्तिं वै मध्यतो यजेत् ।
वरुणानिलयोर्मध्ये प्राकाम्यं कमले न्यसेत् ॥
2.27.m: Between Varuṇa and the Asura, one should worship Prāpti in the centre. / Between Varuṇa and the Wind, one should place Prākāmya on the lotus.

2.27.s:
vitteśānilayormadhye īśitvaṃ sthāpya pūjayet /
vitteśeśānayormadhye vaśitvaṃ sthāpya pūjayet //
2.27.d:
वित्तेशानिलयोर्मध्ये ईशित्वं स्थाप्य पूजयेत् ।
वित्तेशेशानयोर्मध्ये वशित्वं स्थाप्य पूजयेत् ॥
2.27.m: Between the Lord of Wealth and the Wind, having installed Īśitva, one should worship it. / Between the Lord of Wealth and Īśāna, having installed Vaśitva, one should worship it.

2.27.s:
eendreśeśānayormadhye yajetkāmāvasāyakam /
dvitīyāvaraṇaṃ proktaṃ tṛtīyāvaraṇaṃ śuṇu //
2.27.d:
एएन्द्रेशेशानयोर्मध्ये यजेत्कामावसायकम् ।
द्वितीयावरणं प्रोक्तं तृतीयावरणं शुणु ॥
2.27.m: Between Indra and Īśāna, one should worship Kāmāvasāyitā. / The second enclosure has been spoken of; hear of the third enclosure.

2.27.s:
śaktayastu caturviśatpradānakalaśeṣu ca /
pūjayedvyūhamadhye tu pūrvavadvidhipūrvakam //
2.27.d:
शक्तयस्तु चतुर्विशत्प्रदानकलशेषु च ।
पूजयेद्व्यूहमध्ये तु पूर्ववद्विधिपूर्वकम् ॥
2.27.m: And there are twenty-four powers in the principal jars; / one should worship them within the troop as before, following the rule:

2.27.s:
dīkṣāṃ dīkṣāyikāṃ caiva caṇḍāṃ caṇḍāṃśunāyikām /
sumatiṃ sumatyāyīṃ ca gopāṃ gopāyikāṃ tathā //
2.27.d:
दीक्षां दीक्षायिकां चैव चण्डां चण्डांशुनायिकाम् ।
सुमतिं सुमत्यायीं च गोपां गोपायिकां तथा ॥
2.27.m: Dīkṣā and Dīkṣāyikā, Caṇḍā and Caṇḍāṃśunāyikā, / Sumati and Sumatyāyī, Gopā and Gopāyikā,

2.27.s:
atha nandaṃ ca nandāyīṃ pitāmahamataḥ param /
pitāmahāyīṃ pūrvādyaṃ vidhinā sthāpya pūjayet //
2.27.d:
अथ नन्दं च नन्दायीं पितामहमतः परम् ।
पितामहायीं पूर्वाद्यं विधिना स्थाप्य पूजयेत् ॥
2.27.m: then Nanda and Nandāyī, and next Pitāmaha / and Pitāmahāyī; having installed them according to rule beginning in the east, one should worship them.

2.27.s:
erva saṃpūjya vidhinātṛtīyāvaraṇaṃ śubham /
saubhadraṃ vyūhamāsādya prathamāvaraṇe kramāt //
2.27.d:
एर्व संपूज्य विधिनातृतीयावरणं शुभम् ।
सौभद्रं व्यूहमासाद्य प्रथमावरणे क्रमात् ॥
2.27.m: Having thus worshipped the auspicious third enclosure according to rule, / reaching the Saubhadra troop, in the first enclosure in due order,

2.27.s:
prāgādyaṃ vidhinā sthāpya śaktyaṣṭakamanukramāt /
dvitīyāvaraṇe caiva prāgādyaṃ śṛṇu śaktayaḥ //
2.27.d:
प्रागाद्यं विधिना स्थाप्य शक्त्यष्टकमनुक्रमात् ।
द्वितीयावरणे चैव प्रागाद्यं शृणु शक्तयः ॥
2.27.m: having installed according to rule the group of eight powers in succession beginning in the east; / and in the second enclosure, hear of the powers beginning in the east:

2.27.s:
ṣoḍaśaiva tu abhyarcya padmamudrāṃ tu darśayet /
bindukā bindugarbhā ca nādinī nādagarbhajā //
2.27.d:
षोडशैव तु अभ्यर्च्य पद्ममुद्रां तु दर्शयेत् ।
बिन्दुका बिन्दुगर्भा च नादिनी नादगर्भजा ॥
2.27.m: having worshipped sixteen indeed, one should display the lotus gesture. / Bindukā, Bindugarbhā, Nādinī, Nādagarbhajā,

2.27.s:
śaktikā śaktigarbhā ca parā caiva parāparā /
pratamāvaraṇe 'ṣṭau ca śaktayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ //
2.27.d:
शक्तिका शक्तिगर्भा च परा चैव परापरा ।
प्रतमावरणे ऽष्टौ च शक्तयः परिकीर्तिताः ॥
2.27.m: Śaktikā, Śaktigarbhā, Parā, and Parāparā— / these eight powers are declared in the first enclosure.

2.27.s:
caṇḍā caṇḍamukhī caiva caṇḍavegā manojavā /
